keypoints.title: 主要英语国家
keypoints.body: 主要英语国家是指英语在本国社会生活、教育、公共事务或国际交往中发挥重要作用的国家，通常包括英国、美国、加拿大、澳大利亚和新西兰等。学习其基本信息，重点关注名称、地理位置、首都或主要城市等。

keypoints.title: 共同语言与多样国情
keypoints.body: 这些国家都广泛使用英语，但在地理环境、历史背景、政治制度、民族构成和生活方式等方面各有特点。不能因为语言相同，就把它们看成文化和国情完全相同的国家。

exercises.stem: Which statements about major English-speaking countries are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand are commonly listed as major English-speaking countries.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because they all widely use English, they have exactly the same culture and way of life.

choices.label: C
choices.text: These countries differ in geography, history, political systems, ethnic groups and ways of life.

choices.label: D
choices.text: When learning their basic information, we can pay attention to their names, geographical locations, capitals or major cities.

exercises.explanation: A概括了通常所说的主要英语国家；C指出这些国家虽广泛使用英语，但国情和文化具有多样性；D符合学习国家基本信息的重点。B错误，语言相同不代表文化和国情完全相同。

keypoints.title: 教育与生活概况
keypoints.body: 主要英语国家的教育与生活，指这些国家的学校教育、学习方式、家庭与社区生活，以及饮食、交通、休闲等日常生活情况。学习时应以具体事实为依据，了解其共同点与差异。

keypoints.title: 比较文化信息的方法
keypoints.body: 比较不同国家的教育与生活，可按教育阶段、学校日程、家庭结构、出行方式和休闲活动等维度整理信息；先确认资料范围和背景，再归纳异同，避免把个别现象当成普遍规律。

exercises.stem: 某学生准备比较英国和澳大利亚的教育与生活。他找到两条资料：英国某城市一所中学通常8:30开始上课，许多学生乘公共交通或步行上学；澳大利亚某偏远地区一所中学通常9:00开始上课，许多学生乘校车或由家人驾车接送。下列做法最符合比较文化信息的方法的是

choices.label: A
choices.text: 据此认定英国所有学校都比澳大利亚学校开课早。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 说明两条资料的学校类型和地区不同，还需查找更多可比较资料，并从教育阶段、学校日程、出行方式等维度归纳异同。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 只比较上课时间，因为交通方式属于个人选择，与教育生活无关。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 把英国和澳大利亚分别概括为更重视公共交通和更依赖汽车的国家。

exercises.explanation: 两条资料只涉及不同国家中的特定学校和地区，不能直接代表整个国家。可靠的比较应先确认资料范围和背景，补充多种资料，再按学校日程、教育阶段、出行方式等维度整理共同点与差异，避免以个别现象代替普遍规律。

keypoints.title: 历史与社会概况
keypoints.body: 主要英语国家的历史与社会，指这些国家的重要历史发展、社会制度、人口与民族构成、社会生活及其变化。学习重点是理解历史事件与当代社会之间的联系，而不是机械记忆年代和事件。

keypoints.title: 历史塑造社会
keypoints.body: 社会制度、城市发展、语言文化和群体关系都具有历史形成的过程；同一国家内部也可能存在地区、民族、阶层和生活方式差异。因此，应从变化和多样性看待其社会。

exercises.stem: 英国工业化时期，工厂发展和人口集中推动了城市扩张，也改变了劳动关系和社会阶层结构；此后，教育制度的发展以及来自不同地区的人口迁移，又使城市中的语言文化和社区构成更加多样。今天，一些英国城市同时存在传统工业区、金融商业区和具有移民背景的社区。对这段材料理解最恰当的是

choices.label: A
choices.text: 历史发展会影响城市形态、社会制度和群体关系，但当代社会仍具有地区、族群和生活方式等方面的多样性。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 英国当代社会的全部特点都可以由工业化时期的一个历史事件单独解释。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 历史只反映过去的事件，与今天的城市和社会生活没有直接联系。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 一个国家存在共同历史，因此其各地区和各群体的社会生活应当完全相同。

exercises.explanation: 材料把工业化、教育发展和人口迁移与城市形态、劳动关系、社区构成及语言文化联系起来，说明社会制度和群体关系具有历史形成过程。同时，不同类型区域和社区并存，表明同一国家内部也存在多样性，不能用单一经历概括全部社会。

keypoints.title: 地域变体的含义
keypoints.body: 英语的地域变体是英语在不同国家、地区和社群中长期使用后形成的相对稳定的语言形式，可能在发音、词汇、拼写、语法和表达习惯上存在差异。它们都具有交际功能，不能简单按“正确”或“错误”一概评判。

keypoints.title: 地域变体的共同点与差异
keypoints.body: 不同地域变体既共享英语的基本结构和交际功能，又具有本地特色。其形成受历史、移民、社会文化和语言接触等因素影响；理解和使用时应结合说话者、交际对象及场合判断。

exercises.stem: 在国际学生小组中，英国学生说：“I left my mobile in the flat.”美国学生说：“I left my phone in the apartment.”在书面表达中，英国学生常写 colour，美国学生常写 color。对这些现象的分析最恰当的是

choices.label: A
choices.text: 这些词汇和拼写差异体现了英语的地域变体；它们共享基本交际功能，使用时应结合说话者、交际对象和场合判断，不能简单视为正确或错误。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 其中一组表达违反英语规则，因此在任何正式场合都不能使用。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 地域变体之间没有共同的语言结构，使用者通常无法相互理解。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 英语的地域变体只表现为发音不同，词汇和拼写不会发生变化。

exercises.explanation: mobile/phone、flat/apartment以及colour/color分别体现了词汇和拼写方面的地域差异。不同变体仍共享英语的基本结构和交际功能，其形成与历史发展、人口迁移和语言文化接触等有关。表达是否合适要结合交际对象和场合，而不能简单贴上“正确”或“错误”的标签。

keypoints.title: 冲突与适应的含义
keypoints.body: 文化冲突是不同文化背景的人因价值观、社会规范、交往方式或行为期待不同，在理解、判断或互动中产生的误解、紧张甚至对立。文化适应则是在新文化环境中调整认知、情感和行为，同时保持合理的自我认同。

keypoints.title: 应对文化冲突的方法
keypoints.body: 先观察事实并确认对方意图，再用尊重、具体的语言说明自己的习惯；通过倾听、解释和协商寻找共同点，适当调整行为，逐步适应新的文化环境。

exercises.stem: During an exchange, Chen notices that his host family does not repeatedly offer him food at dinner. In Chen's family, a host usually offers dishes several times, so he first feels ignored. Which response best shows both an appropriate understanding of cultural conflict and cultural adaptation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Treat the difference as proof that the host family is unfriendly and ask them to change.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Observe the actual behavior, politely ask about the host family's intention, explain his own expectation, listen to their explanation, and then adjust how he offers or accepts food while keeping his own identity.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Say nothing and force himself to copy every behavior of the host family.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ask another Chinese student to judge the family and avoid eating with them.

exercises.explanation: Different expectations about offering food may cause a cultural conflict, but the behavior alone does not prove bad intentions. Chen should first observe and confirm the meaning, then explain his own habit respectfully, listen and negotiate. Adjusting his behavior while retaining reasonable self-identity is cultural adaptation.

keypoints.title: 社会规约与礼仪是什么
keypoints.body: 社会规约是群体成员普遍认可并遵守的行为规范，礼仪是人们在交往中表达尊重、友善和得体的方式。中外差异可能表现在称谓、问候、身体距离、用餐方式、时间观念和告别方式等方面。

keypoints.title: 礼仪差异具有情境性
keypoints.body: 社会规约和礼仪会受国家、地区、民族、年龄、职业及交往场合影响，不能把某种做法当作所有人的固定特征。跨文化交往时应先观察情境，必要时礼貌询问并尊重对方习惯。

exercises.stem: At an international student club, a visitor from another country does not shake hands when greeted. Which action best reflects an appropriate understanding of social conventions and etiquette?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Assume that all people from the visitor's country dislike physical contact and avoid speaking to them.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Observe the situation and the visitor's response, politely ask what form of greeting is comfortable, and respect the visitor's preference.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Insist on shaking hands because it is the only polite greeting.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Make a joke about the visitor's unusual behavior so that everyone can notice it.

exercises.explanation: Social conventions and etiquette can vary with country, region, age, profession, personal preference and situation. One person's behavior should not be generalized to a whole group. Observing the context, asking politely when necessary, and respecting the other person's preference is the most appropriate response.

keypoints.title: 文化多样性的含义
keypoints.body: 文化多样性是不同群体在语言、信仰、价值观、生活方式、传统习俗和艺术表达等方面呈现的差异与共存状态，是人类社会的客观现象。

keypoints.title: 理解与尊重的原则
keypoints.body: 理解文化多样性要结合具体历史和社会背景认识差异，避免以单一标准或刻板印象评价他者。尊重不等于对所有做法都赞同，而是在维护基本尊严和权利的基础上平等交流、包容差异。

exercises.stem: During a class discussion, a student says, “Their traditional clothing is strange. They should dress like us if they want to be modern.” Which reply best demonstrates understanding and respect for cultural diversity?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Every cultural practice must be accepted as completely right, so people should never ask questions about it.

choices.label: B
choices.text: We can learn about the clothing's historical and social meaning and listen to members of that community. We should respect their dignity and choices without assuming that our standard is the only one, while still considering basic rights when discussing any practice.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Our clothing is normal, so it is a suitable standard for judging all other clothing.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is better to avoid people whose customs and appearance are different from ours.

exercises.explanation: Understanding cultural diversity requires considering the historical and social background of a practice and avoiding stereotypes or a single standard. Respect means equal communication and protection of dignity and rights; it does not require agreeing with every cultural practice uncritically.

keypoints.title: 中国故事与文化自信
keypoints.body: 用英语准确、生动地介绍中国历史、文化、社会发展和当代生活，表达对中华文化价值的认同，同时尊重不同文化，以平等、开放的态度增进理解，而不是夸大或贬低任何一方。

keypoints.title: 讲好中国故事的方法
keypoints.body: 先选择真实、具体且有代表性的内容，再说明背景、主要特点和现实意义；根据听众的语言水平和文化背景组织表达，必要时解释专有名词，并用事实和恰当比较增强说服力。

exercises.stem: You are preparing a short English introduction for exchange students who know little about China. Which version best follows the principles of telling a Chinese story and building cultural confidence?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Dragon Boat Festival is China's greatest festival. Everyone eats zongzi and races dragon boats because Chinese people have always been united. Foreign festivals are less meaningful.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Dragon Boat Festival falls on the fifth day of the fifth month in the traditional lunar calendar. It is often associated with remembering Qu Yuan, a poet and statesman of ancient China. Today, many communities mark it with activities such as dragon-boat racing and eating zongzi, or rice dumplings. Customs differ from place to place, but they continue to connect history with people's lives.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Dragon Boat Festival is a mysterious ancient event. Qu Yuan invented dragon boats, and all Chinese people celebrate it in exactly the same way. You do not need to know the background.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Dragon Boat Festival is just like a foreign holiday, so there is nothing special to explain. Chinese culture is valuable only because it is older than other cultures.

exercises.explanation: B选择了真实、具体且有代表性的节日，交代了时间和与屈原相关的文化背景，并解释了zongzi这一专有文化词语；同时说明不同地区的习俗可能不同，体现了文化认同而不夸大、不贬低其他文化。A和D带有比较和价值判断，C含有错误信息且缺少背景说明。

keypoints.title: 戏剧与影视作品
keypoints.body: 戏剧与影视作品是通过人物、情节、对白、表演、画面和声音等手段表现生活、冲突、情感与思想的艺术作品，包括中国和其他国家的舞台剧、电影、电视剧等。

keypoints.title: 作品的文化表达
keypoints.body: 戏剧与影视作品既有故事和审美价值，也会反映创作者所处时代的社会生活、价值观念和文化特色。欣赏时应兼顾内容、人物、表现手法及文化背景，尊重不同作品的表达方式。

exercises.stem: Consider this scene from an imaginary Chinese film, The Last Ferry: An elderly ferryman refuses to leave his riverside village after a bridge opens. His granddaughter asks him to record the village songs before the ferry stops. The scene uses long shots of the river, pauses in dialogue, and the local dialect with subtitles. Which comment is the most appropriate evaluation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The scene is successful because old people should always reject new technology.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The scene is about a grandfather and granddaughter; the plot is enough, so the visual and sound choices do not matter.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The conflict between staying and changing gives the characters emotional depth. Long shots, pauses, and the dialect with subtitles shape the mood and present a local cultural world. The scene may invite reflection on tradition, memory, and modernization, while viewers should avoid treating one character's choice as the attitude of all rural people.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because the film uses a local dialect, it cannot communicate beyond the village and is less artistic than a film in standard English.

exercises.explanation: C同时关注了情节冲突、人物情感、画面和声音等表现手法，并联系传统、记忆与现代化的文化背景进行理解；“may invite reflection”也避免把作品意义说得过于绝对。A和D是片面或带有偏见的判断，B忽略了影视作品的艺术表现手段。

keypoints.title: 英语文学名著与作家
keypoints.body: 英语文学名著是用英语创作、具有较高艺术价值和持久影响力的文学作品；相关作家是创作这些作品并形成独特思想与艺术风格的作者，作品可涵盖诗歌、小说、戏剧等体裁。

keypoints.title: 阅读名著的要点
keypoints.body: 阅读时先梳理情节和人物关系，再关注叙述方式、语言特色与核心主题，并结合作者所处的时代和文化背景理解作品；表达观点时要以文本中的情节、语言或形象为依据。

exercises.stem: A student is reading Mary Shelley's Frankenstein. Which reading note best follows the recommended approach to reading an English literary classic?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The novel is about a monster, so I can understand it by deciding that the creature is evil from the beginning. The author's personal life is more important than the text.

choices.label: B
choices.text: I will list the events only. Since the story was written long ago, its ideas about science and responsibility cannot speak to readers today.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I will first map the relationships among Walton, Victor, and the creature, and notice the framed narration and changes of voice. Then I will examine the novel's imagery and the creature's account of learning and rejection, and use these details to discuss science, responsibility, and social prejudice in its early-nineteenth-century context.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The writer's name tells me the novel must praise science, so I need not check the plot or language.

exercises.explanation: C先梳理人物关系和叙述结构，再关注意象、叙述声音及具体情节，并结合十九世纪初的时代背景讨论主题，符合从情节人物到语言艺术、主题和文化背景的阅读顺序。它还以作品中的叙述和情节为依据。A、B、D或武断下结论，或只看情节、作者而忽略文本证据。

keypoints.title: 中外音乐与美术
keypoints.body: 中外音乐与美术是中国及其他国家和地区的音乐、绘画、雕塑等艺术形式。它们分别借助声音、节奏、色彩、线条、形体和构图等媒介，表达情感、观念和审美追求。

keypoints.title: 欣赏艺术作品的方法
keypoints.body: 欣赏音乐可关注旋律、节奏、音色和情绪；欣赏美术可观察题材、构图、色彩、材质和技法；再联系作品的时代与文化背景，说明自己的感受，并尊重不同审美传统。

exercises.stem: A student is asked to appreciate a Western symphony and a Chinese ink landscape. Which approach is most appropriate?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Decide which work is superior solely by whether it resembles the style one already knows.

choices.label: B
choices.text: For the symphony, attend to melody, rhythm, timbre and emotion; for the ink landscape, observe its subject, composition, color, material and technique, then relate both works to their cultural backgrounds and respect different aesthetic traditions.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Focus only on the artists’ nationalities and use them to predict the artistic value of the works.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Judge both works mainly by whether they present a complete and realistic story.

exercises.explanation: 欣赏音乐应关注旋律、节奏、音色和情绪；欣赏美术应观察题材、构图、色彩、材质和技法。同时，还要联系时代与文化背景，形成自己的感受并尊重不同审美传统。B项完整体现了这些方法。

keypoints.title: 价值观的含义
keypoints.body: 文学作品中的价值观，是作品通过人物、情节、叙述或意象表现出的对善恶、美丑、责任、自由等问题的态度和评价，体现作品所肯定、否定或反思的价值取向。

keypoints.title: 辨析作品价值取向
keypoints.body: 阅读时关注人物的选择及其后果、情节冲突的解决方式、叙述者的评价和反复出现的意象，再结合全文语境判断作品的价值取向，不能简单把某个人物的观点等同于作者观点。

exercises.stem:
Read the original passage and answer the question.

At the town meeting, Leo said, “A false report will save our shop. People care about results, not truth.” His sister Mia disagreed and admitted the mistake they had made. The report was corrected; the shop lost a day’s business, but customers returned after learning what Mia had done. The narrator ends: “A clean sign could be repainted; trust, once erased, was harder to restore.”

Which statement best explains the work’s value orientation?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It celebrates deception whenever deception brings immediate commercial success.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It affirms honesty and responsibility, while Leo’s opinion should not simply be treated as the author’s view.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It suggests that financial loss is more important than trust.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It refuses to make any judgment about the difference between honesty and deception.

exercises.explanation: Leo主张用虚假报告保住生意，但情节结果表明诚实会赢得顾客的信任，结尾意象也明确强调信任的价值。因此作品肯定诚实与责任。不能把Leo的观点直接等同于作者观点，应结合人物后果和叙述者评价判断。

keypoints.title: 连接词语的作用
keypoints.body: 连接词语衔接是借助连词、连接副词或连接短语，明确句子、分句或段落之间的逻辑关系，使语意在形式上相互连接、在理解上更加顺畅。

keypoints.title: 按逻辑选择连接词
keypoints.body: 先判断前后内容的关系，再选择恰当的连接词：并列或递进可用and、also，转折可用but、however，因果可用because、therefore，顺序可用first、then等，并检查前后语意是否一致。

exercises.stem: Choose one word from “and / however / therefore / first / then” to complete the sentence: The laboratory lost power; ___, the experiment had to be postponed.
exercises.explanation: 前句“实验室停电”是原因，后句“实验不得不推迟”是由此产生的结果，因此应使用表示因果结果的连接副词“therefore”。

keypoints.title: 语篇标记语的含义
keypoints.body: 语篇标记语是提示语篇组织、话题转换、信息补充、举例、总结或说话者态度的词语或短语，如first、however、in fact、for example、in conclusion等，帮助读者把握表达思路。

keypoints.title: 提示结构与态度
keypoints.body: 语篇标记语的核心作用是引导理解，通常不充当句子的主要成分；删去后句子语法上可能仍成立，但逻辑层次、转折关系或说话者态度往往不够明显。

exercises.stem: Choose the best discourse marker for the blank: “The new bus route is cheaper and faster. ___, it does not run after 9 p.m.”

choices.label: A
choices.text: For example

choices.label: B
choices.text: However

choices.label: C
choices.text: In conclusion

choices.label: D
choices.text: Similarly

exercises.explanation: “However” signals a contrast: the bus route has advantages, but it also has a limitation. It is a discourse marker that guides the reader to understand the logical relationship between the two sentences; removing it would not make the second sentence grammatically incorrect, but the contrast would be less explicit.

keypoints.title: 词汇衔接的含义
keypoints.body: 词汇衔接是语篇中通过词语的重复、同义或近义、反义、上下义、词语搭配以及同一语义场等关系，使不同句子围绕相关意义相互联系。

keypoints.title: 追踪词汇链
keypoints.body: 阅读时圈出反复出现或意义相关的词语，将它们按人物、地点、事件或主题归组，观察词汇链如何延续和变化，从而把握语篇主题及内容推进。

exercises.stem: Read the paragraph: “Our neighborhood opened a community garden in May. Volunteers prepared the soil and planted tomatoes, beans, and herbs. Each week, they watered the vegetables, removed weeds, and recorded the plants’ growth. By August, the garden supplied fresh produce to several families.” Which option best identifies the lexical chain that connects the sentences and helps reveal the main topic?

choices.label: A
choices.text: garden—soil—planted—tomatoes—beans—herbs—vegetables—watered—weeds—plants—growth—produce

choices.label: B
choices.text: neighborhood—May—week—August—families

choices.label: C
choices.text: volunteers—several—fresh—community

choices.label: D
choices.text: opened—prepared—recorded—supplied

exercises.explanation: The words in A are repeated or semantically related and belong to the same field of gardening and plant growth. Together they form a lexical chain that shows how the paragraph develops the topic of the community garden. B mainly contains places, time expressions, and people, while D consists mainly of verbs and does not represent the central semantic field as clearly.

keypoints.title: 指代衔接的含义
keypoints.body: 指语篇中用代词、指示词或其他指示性表达，指向上下文中已出现或将出现的人、事物、时间、地点等，使句子之间建立意义联系，减少重复并保持语篇连贯。

keypoints.title: 判断指代对象
keypoints.body: 阅读时先找出指代词，再结合数、人称、句法位置和上下文意义确定所指对象；不能只按距离最近的名词判断，还要检查前后信息是否一致。

exercises.stem: Read the sentences: “The librarian lent the students a set of microscopes. They worked in pairs to examine pond water and recorded their observations in a shared notebook.” What does “They” refer to?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The librarian

choices.label: B
choices.text: The students

choices.label: C
choices.text: The microscopes

choices.label: D
choices.text: The pond water

exercises.explanation: “They” is a plural pronoun, so it cannot refer to the singular librarian, a set of microscopes considered as a set, or pond water. The meaning also confirms that the students worked in pairs and recorded observations; microscopes cannot perform these actions. Thus, “They” refers to “the students,” even though “microscopes” appears nearby.

keypoints.title: 替代与省略的含义
keypoints.body: 替代与省略都是语篇衔接手段：替代用代词、替代词或替代结构代替前文成分；省略则省去语境中可补出的成分，借此避免重复，使表达简洁。

keypoints.title: 根据语境还原
keypoints.body: 理解时先根据句法结构判断缺少或被替代的成分，再回到前文寻找语义和形式相匹配的内容；补全后应保证句意、时态、数和逻辑关系通顺。

exercises.stem: Read the sentence: “The first team completed the project on time, but the second did not.” Which analysis best explains how repetition is avoided in the second clause?

choices.label: A
choices.text: “The second” means “the second team”, and “did not” stands for “did not complete the project on time”; the missing information can be recovered from the first clause.

choices.label: B
choices.text: “Did” means “completed”, and “not” shows that the second team did not take part in the project at all.

choices.label: C
choices.text: “The second” means “the second project”, and “did not” stands for “was not on time”.

choices.label: D
choices.text: “Did not” means that the second team refused to work, although the first clause does not provide this information.

exercises.explanation: “The second” is an elliptical form of “the second team”, while “did not” replaces “did not complete the project on time”. The omitted or substituted parts are understood from the first clause, which avoids repeating the same words.

keypoints.title: 主题推进与连贯
keypoints.body: 主题推进与连贯是指语篇围绕中心主题组织信息，使句子和段落在内容、逻辑及表达顺序上逐步展开，前后相互联系、意义完整，读者能够清楚把握信息发展。

keypoints.title: 分析信息发展
keypoints.body: 分析语篇时先概括中心主题，再标出各句的已知信息与新信息，观察其通过重复、解释、递进、因果、转折等方式展开；若信息跳跃或缺少必要联系，连贯性会减弱。

exercises.stem:
Choose the sentence that best completes the paragraph and maintains its topic progression and coherence.

Many schools are creating small gardens on their campuses. These gardens are not simply decorations; they are outdoor classrooms. Students can observe how seeds become plants and record changes each week. Teachers can use these observations in science lessons. ________. In this way, a school garden connects science learning with students’ daily lives.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Working with real plants can make scientific ideas more concrete and meaningful.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The school’s football team practises on the field every Friday.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Some students choose to read novels during the lunch break.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Gardens in different countries may contain different flowers.

exercises.explanation: The paragraph develops the topic from school gardens, to students’ observations, to their use in science lessons. Option A adds the result that real plants make scientific ideas more concrete, which naturally leads to the concluding sentence about connecting science learning with daily life. The other options interrupt the topic development.

keypoints.title: 议论文的含义
keypoints.body: 议论文是以提出并论证观点为主要目的的语篇，通常围绕中心论点，借助事实、数据、事例或道理论据进行推理，得出结论并影响读者的判断。

keypoints.title: 观点与论证结构
keypoints.body: 议论文重在表达观点并展开论证，结构常表现为论点、论据、论证和结论；语言通常较准确、严密，常使用表示因果、转折、条件和推断的连接词，使论证关系清晰。

exercises.stem: Which paragraph best demonstrates the main features of argumentative writing?

choices.label: A
choices.text: School libraries should remain open for one extra hour after classes. A survey at one school found that 68% of students needed a quiet place to study before going home. Moreover, the extended hours would help students who lack a suitable study space at home. Therefore, keeping the library open longer is a practical way to support equal learning opportunities.

choices.label: B
choices.text: At four o’clock, the rain stopped. I put my bag under my coat and ran to the bus stop. A dog followed me until the bus arrived.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A school library usually contains shelves, desks, computers, and a borrowing counter. Its quiet atmosphere makes it different from a classroom.

choices.label: D
choices.text: First, choose a book. Next, scan its barcode. Finally, return it to the desk before the due date.

exercises.explanation: Option A presents a clear claim that libraries should extend their opening hours, supports it with survey data and a reason, and uses “Moreover” and “Therefore” to make the logic explicit before reaching a conclusion. The other paragraphs are mainly narrative, descriptive, or instructional.

keypoints.title: 说明文是什么
keypoints.body: 说明文是以介绍事物、解释现象或阐明事理为主要目的的语篇，重在传递信息、说明特征和揭示规律，而不是讲述故事或抒发个人情感。

keypoints.title: 说明文的主要特点
keypoints.body: 内容通常准确、客观、条理清晰，常按时间、空间、逻辑或总分关系组织；语言具体严谨，常使用定义、分类、举例、比较和列数据等说明方法。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and choose the best description of its text type and main feature.

Why do some metals rust? Rusting is a chemical reaction. When iron is exposed to both oxygen and water, a reddish-brown substance gradually forms on its surface. Salt can make the process faster. Keeping iron dry or covering it with paint can slow rusting.

choices.label: A
choices.text: It tells a story through a character’s changing feelings.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It tries to persuade readers to buy a product by using an attractive slogan.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It explains a phenomenon objectively by presenting causes and ways to prevent it.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It reports a newly happened event and mainly presents witnesses’ comments.

exercises.explanation: 文章围绕“金属为什么生锈”这一现象进行解释，说明了生锈的条件、影响因素和减缓方法，内容客观，按因果关系组织，符合说明文介绍现象、揭示规律的特点。

keypoints.title: 记叙文是什么
keypoints.body: 记叙文是以人物、事件、经历或场景为主要内容，按照一定线索叙述发展过程的语篇，常通过叙事表现人物特点、传达感受或揭示意义。

keypoints.title: 记叙文的主要特点
keypoints.body: 通常包含人物、事件、时间、地点等要素，按时间、空间或事件发展组织内容；语言具有叙述性，常结合描写、对话和心理活动，使情节和人物形象更具体。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and choose the best analysis of its text type.

At 7:10 on a rainy Monday morning, Mia reached the school gate. She noticed a small paper boat moving slowly along the flooded sidewalk. “Maybe someone needs help,” she said. Following the boat, she found a little boy looking for his lost dog. Mia helped him search, and she felt relieved when the dog finally appeared behind a tree.

choices.label: A
choices.text: It is an expository text because it classifies information and explains a natural process.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It is a narrative because it centers on a character and an event that develops in time, with dialogue and feelings.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It is a news report because it gives objective information about a recent public event.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is an advertisement because it uses a slogan and calls on readers to take action.

exercises.explanation: 文章以Mia为中心，交代了时间、地点和人物，通过“发现纸船—寻找男孩—找到小狗”的事件发展来推进内容，并加入对话和感受，体现了记叙文的叙事性和描写性。

keypoints.title: 两类文体是什么
keypoints.body: 新闻报道以真实、及时地传播事实和信息为目的；广告以介绍、宣传商品、服务或理念，影响受众选择和行动为目的。二者都面向特定受众组织内容。

keypoints.title: 表达特点有何不同
keypoints.body: 新闻报道重事实、时效和客观性，常突出标题、导语和关键信息；广告重吸引力、说服力和记忆性，常使用简洁口号、突出卖点和号召性表达。

exercises.stem:
Read Texts A and B and choose the correct analysis.

Text A
On Tuesday, the Greenfield City Library reopened after a three-month renovation. According to the library director, the building now has a children’s reading room and 20 additional computers. More than 500 residents visited on the first day.

Text B
Read more, discover more! Join BrightPath Online Library today. Enjoy thousands of e-books on your phone, and sign up before Friday to receive a free one-month membership. Start your reading journey now!

choices.label: A
choices.text: Text A is an advertisement, while Text B is a news report.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Both texts are news reports because both provide information to readers.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Text A is a news report focusing on a timely event and factual details, while Text B is an advertisement using benefits and a call to action.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both texts are advertisements because both are written for a particular audience.

exercises.explanation: Text A报道图书馆重新开放这一及时发生的事实，提供时间、地点、来源和数据，重在客观传递信息。Text B突出服务卖点，使用“Read more, discover more”等口号，并以优惠和“Start...”号召读者行动，具有广告的吸引力和说服性。

keypoints.title: 非连续性文本是什么
keypoints.body: 非连续性文本不是以连续段落为主要组织形式，而是借助表格、图表、流程图、地图、清单、表单等信息单元共同表达内容的语篇。

exercises.stem:
Read the non-continuous text and answer the question.

After-school Study Spaces Used by Grade 12 Students
(Number of students; 200 students surveyed)

| Place | Monday | Wednesday | Friday |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Library | 72 | 80 | 76 |
| Classroom | 54 | 48 | 60 |
| Home | 50 | 46 | 42 |
| Café | 24 | 26 | 22 |

Which statement is supported by the table?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The library was the most popular study place on each of the three days.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The number of students using the classroom rose from Monday to Wednesday to Friday.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The number of students studying at home was highest on Friday.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The café was used by more students than the classroom on Wednesday.

exercises.explanation: 先根据标题明确表格主题，再注意单位是“学生人数”，逐列比较各学习地点的数据。图书馆在周一、周三和周五的人数分别为72、80和76，均高于其他地点，因此A正确。B、C、D分别与表中数据不符。

keypoints.title: 应用文是什么
keypoints.body: 应用文是为解决实际事务、传递具体信息或完成特定交际目的而写的文章，通常面向明确的对象、场合和任务。

keypoints.title: 应用文的主要特征
keypoints.body: 应用文目的明确、对象具体、格式相对规范，内容注重真实、准确、简明，语言要符合交际场合和双方关系，常包含称呼、正文、结尾等要素。

exercises.stem: You are a student writing to the school library staff to ask for a one-week renewal of a book that is due tomorrow. You need the book for exam preparation. Which email is the most appropriate?

choices.label: A
choices.text:
Dear Library Staff,

I am writing to ask whether I may renew the book I borrowed, which is due tomorrow. I am using it to prepare for my exams. Could you please let me know if a one-week renewal is possible?

Thank you for your help.

Yours sincerely,
Li Hua

choices.label: B
choices.text:
Hi! I need the book for longer, so please don't make me return it tomorrow, OK? I really need it. Bye!
Li Hua

choices.label: C
choices.text:
Dear Library Staff,

Book renewal. Exam. One week.

Please reply quickly.

Li Hua

choices.label: D
choices.text:
Hey librarian,

This book is great. I want to keep it until I feel like returning it. Let me know soon.

Li Hua

exercises.explanation: 这是面向图书馆工作人员、为解决借阅期限问题而写的应用文。A有明确的称呼、具体请求、必要说明、礼貌表达和规范结尾，内容准确简明，符合正式交际场合。B和D过于口语化且语气不得体，C信息不完整、格式和表达也不够自然。

keypoints.title: 语体的基本含义
keypoints.body: 正式语体用于较严肃、规范的场合，表达完整、礼貌、克制；非正式语体用于熟人或轻松场合，表达自然、口语化，形式更灵活。

keypoints.title: 根据场合选择语体
keypoints.body: 先判断交际对象、关系、目的和场合，再选择语体。正式语体多用规范词语、完整句式和礼貌表达，避免俚语；非正式语体可用日常词语、缩略形式，但仍要清楚得体。

exercises.stem: You were absent from a lecture and are emailing an unfamiliar professor to ask where you can find the lecture notes. Which message best suits the situation?

choices.label: A
choices.text:
Dear Professor Smith,

I was absent from yesterday's lecture. Could you please tell me where I can find the lecture notes?

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
Li Hua

choices.label: B
choices.text: Hey Prof! I missed class. Can you send me the notes ASAP? Thanks!

choices.label: C
choices.text: Hi, I wasn't there yesterday, so just send me whatever I need. Thx.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Professor Smith, I wanna get the notes from yesterday's lecture. Tell me where they are.

exercises.explanation: 交际对象是并不熟悉的教授，目的较正式，因此应使用规范词语、完整句式和礼貌表达。A使用Dear、Could you please、Best regards等正式表达，语气克制得体。B、C、D含有Hey、ASAP、Thx、wanna等口语化或较直接的表达，不适合该场合。

keypoints.title: 夸张与反语定义
keypoints.body: 夸张是为了突出特征或强化感情，故意把事物说得过分；反语是故意使用表面意义与真实意图不一致，甚至相反的表达。

keypoints.title: 不要只按字面理解
keypoints.body: 夸张通常不是事实陈述，不能照字面当真；判断反语要结合上下文、语气和交际情境，不能把所有特殊或不合常理的表达都看作反语。

exercises.stem:
Read the two utterances and choose the option that correctly identifies the main rhetorical device in each one.
(1) After waiting only five minutes for a reply, Ben said, “I’ve waited a million years for your message.”
(2) When heavy rain ruined the picnic, Lily looked at the wet food and said with a sigh, “What wonderful weather for a picnic!”

choices.label: A
choices.text: (1) Hyperbole; (2) irony

choices.label: B
choices.text: (1) Irony; (2) hyperbole

choices.label: C
choices.text: (1) Metaphor; (2) personification

choices.label: D
choices.text: (1) Literal statement; (2) literal statement

exercises.explanation: “A million years” greatly exaggerates the actual five-minute wait to emphasize impatience, so it is hyperbole. In the second utterance, “wonderful weather” appears positive on the surface, but the rainy situation and Lily’s sigh show that she really means the opposite, so it is irony. Neither expression should be understood purely literally.

keypoints.title: 比喻与拟人定义
keypoints.body: 比喻借助具有相似性的事物说明或描写另一事物；拟人则把人的动作、情感、性格等赋予非人的事物，使其呈现人的特点。

keypoints.title: 识别表达作用
keypoints.body: 发现两种事物之间的相似联系，或出现非人事物实施人的行为、流露人的情感时，可分别判断为比喻或拟人。它们常使描写更具体、生动，增强画面感和感染力。

exercises.stem:
Which option correctly identifies the rhetorical devices in the following two sentences?
(1) The moon was a silver coin above the rooftops.
(2) The old house complained about the cold wind.

choices.label: A
choices.text: (1) Metaphor; (2) personification

choices.label: B
choices.text: (1) Personification; (2) metaphor

choices.label: C
choices.text: (1) Hyperbole; (2) irony

choices.label: D
choices.text: (1) Repetition; (2) parallelism

exercises.explanation: In (1), the moon is compared to a silver coin because of their similar round shape and bright appearance, so the sentence uses a metaphor. In (2), the non-human house is given the human action of “complaining,” so the sentence uses personification. These devices make the description more vivid and create a clearer image.

keypoints.title: 排比与反复的含义
keypoints.body: 排比是把三个或三个以上结构相近、语气一致的句子或短语连续排列；反复是为突出意义或强化感情，有意重复某个词、短语、句子或相同句式。

keypoints.title: 两者的表达效果
keypoints.body: 排比能增强语言气势，形成层次感和节奏感；反复能突出重点、强化情感和语气。判断时要区分：排比重在多个结构相似的成分并列，反复重在相同语言成分再次出现。

exercises.stem:
Which option correctly identifies the main rhetorical device in each sentence?
(1) She opened the window, swept the floor, and watered the plants.
(2) “Never give up; never give up when the road is hard,” the coach told the team.

choices.label: A
choices.text: (1) Parallelism; (2) repetition

choices.label: B
choices.text: (1) Repetition; (2) parallelism

choices.label: C
choices.text: (1) Irony; (2) hyperbole

choices.label: D
choices.text: (1) Metaphor; (2) personification

exercises.explanation: Sentence (1) places three structurally similar verb phrases—“opened...,” “swept...,” and “watered...” —in succession, so it is parallelism. Sentence (2) deliberately repeats the phrase “Never give up” to stress determination and strengthen the coach’s tone, so it is repetition. The first emphasizes several parallel actions, while the second emphasizes the repeated language.

keypoints.title: 因果结构的含义
keypoints.body: 因果结构按照原因与结果之间的逻辑关系组织语篇，可以先说明原因、后呈现结果，也可以先提出结果、再解释原因，使事件或观点的来龙去脉清晰明白。

keypoints.title: 识别因果关系
keypoints.body: 阅读时先找出“为什么”与“造成了什么”，再关注 because、so、therefore、as a result 等因果标志，判断句子或段落是原因—结果还是结果—原因，并梳理它们的对应关系。

exercises.stem:
阅读下面的语篇，判断其中的因果关系：
The cafeteria stopped selling drinks in single-use plastic cups. Because of this change, many students began bringing reusable cups to school. As a result, the amount of plastic waste on campus fell.
Which statement best describes the causal relationship in the paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The decrease in plastic waste caused the cafeteria to stop selling single-use cups.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The cafeteria’s decision led students to bring reusable cups, which then helped reduce plastic waste.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The paragraph mainly contrasts reusable cups with single-use cups.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The paragraph describes the location of the cafeteria and the school campus.

exercises.explanation: 停止销售一次性塑料杯是原因，促使学生携带可重复使用的杯子；学生的这一变化又导致校园塑料垃圾减少。“Because of this change”和“As a result”分别提示原因与结果，整体是原因先出现、结果随后呈现的因果结构。

keypoints.title: 两种顺序的含义
keypoints.body: 时间顺序按事件发生的先后组织内容；空间顺序按事物所处的位置、方向或观察视角组织内容，如由近及远、由外到内、由整体到局部。

keypoints.title: 判断语篇顺序
keypoints.body: 看到 first、then、finally 或表示先后的时间表达，通常可判断为时间顺序；看到 next to、above、behind 等方位表达，或内容随观察路线变化，通常可判断为空间顺序。

exercises.stem:
阅读两个语篇片段，判断它们采用的篇章顺序。
A. First, the science club collected used batteries. Then, it sorted them by type. Finally, it sent them to a recycling center.
B. At the library entrance is the help desk. Next to it stands a row of computers. Behind the computers are the shelves for new books.
Which option correctly identifies the organization of A and B?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A uses spatial order, and B uses time order.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A uses time order, and B uses spatial order.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both A and B use time order.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Both A and B use comparison-and-contrast structure.

exercises.explanation: 片段A用“First、Then、Finally”按照收集、分类、送去回收的先后叙述，是时间顺序。片段B按照入口、旁边、后方的位置变化介绍图书馆内的物体，是空间顺序。

keypoints.title: 比较对照的含义
keypoints.body: 比较—对照结构围绕两个或多个对象，从相同方面比较其共同点和不同点；其中，对照更强调差异，常用于帮助读者全面认识对象或突出某一特点。

keypoints.title: 梳理比较维度
keypoints.body: 先确定比较对象，再找出共同的比较维度，如外形、功能、原因或结果，分别记录相同点和不同点，并关注 similarly、both、however、unlike 等提示关系的词语。

exercises.stem:
阅读下面的语篇，判断其篇章结构：
Both bicycles and electric scooters can help people travel short distances without using a car. Bicycles are usually cheaper and do not need charging, whereas electric scooters require a battery but may be easier for some riders on uphill roads. Unlike bicycles, many electric scooters can be folded and carried into a building.
Which statement best describes the organization of the paragraph?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It explains a cause and its effects.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It presents events in the order in which they happened.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It compares bicycles and electric scooters through their shared function and differences in cost, charging, use, and portability.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It describes the objects by moving from the entrance of a building to its interior.

exercises.explanation: 语篇先指出自行车和电动滑板车都能满足短途出行这一共同点，再从价格、是否需要充电、上坡使用和便携性等维度说明差异。“Both、whereas、Unlike”是比较—对照结构的提示词。

keypoints.title: 结构的基本形式
keypoints.body: 总分总结构是语篇先概括提出中心内容，再分层说明具体信息，最后总结、回应或提升中心内容的篇章组织方式。

keypoints.title: 识别与运用
keypoints.body: 阅读时先找开头的总述、主体的分述和结尾的回扣，观察各部分是否围绕同一中心；写作时可按“提出中心—展开要点—总结照应”安排内容。

exercises.stem: Read the paragraph and choose the best description of its organization. School gardens can be valuable learning spaces, not merely places to grow vegetables. In biology, students can observe plant growth; in mathematics, they can measure areas and calculate harvests; in social studies, they can discuss food and the environment. By connecting several subjects with practical work, a school garden makes learning more active and meaningful.

choices.label: A
choices.text: It presents a general idea, develops it with several supporting details, and returns to the main idea in the conclusion.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It introduces a problem, explains its causes, and then offers solutions.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It describes events in the order in which they happened.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It compares two different kinds of learning spaces.

exercises.explanation: 第一句概括提出学校花园具有学习价值；中间分别从生物、数学和社会学习等方面展开说明；最后一句总结并回应开头的中心内容。因此，文章采用“总述—分述—总结”的总分总结构。

keypoints.title: 问题与解决的组织
keypoints.body: 问题—解决结构是语篇先呈现问题或困难，随后分析其原因、影响或需求，再提出一种或多种解决办法，并可说明结果或评价的组织方式。

keypoints.title: 识别与表达方法
keypoints.body: 阅读时先定位问题及其表现，再寻找表示建议、措施或行动的内容；写作时应使解决办法针对前文问题，并说明实施后的效果或意义。

exercises.stem: Read the paragraph and choose the best description of its organization. Takeaway meals create a growing waste problem in our community. Because many containers are used only once and local recycling facilities cannot process all mixed materials, a large number end up in landfills. Restaurants can offer discounts to customers who bring reusable boxes, and the city can place clearly labeled collection bins near busy shops. If these measures are followed, less waste will be sent to landfills and customers will have more sustainable choices.

choices.label: A
choices.text: It presents a problem, explains its causes, proposes solutions, and describes their possible effects.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It states a general opinion and supports it with examples before repeating the opinion.

choices.label: C
choices.text: It introduces two opposing views and evaluates their advantages.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It tells a story by presenting several events in time order.

exercises.explanation: 段落先指出外卖餐盒造成的废弃物问题，接着说明一次性使用和回收能力不足等原因，然后提出商家优惠、设置回收箱等解决办法，最后说明措施可能带来的效果，符合“问题—解决”结构。

keypoints.title: 两类信息的含义
keypoints.body: 段落主题句是概括段落中心意思的句子；支撑细节是解释、举例、列数据、说明原因或补充事实等支持主题句的信息。

keypoints.title: 中心与细节的关系
keypoints.body: 主题句统领段落内容，支撑细节围绕它展开并使观点具体可信。主题句常位于段首，也可能出现在段中或段末，不能只按位置判断。

exercises.stem: Read the paragraph. Which sentence is the topic sentence? [1] Many students believe that studying longer always leads to better results. [2] In fact, the way students use their study time often matters more than the number of hours. [3] For example, making a short plan before studying helps them focus on the most important tasks. [4] Turning off phone notifications reduces interruptions. [5] Reviewing key points at the end of a session also helps them remember what they have learned.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Sentence [1], because it introduces a common belief.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Sentence [2], because it states the central idea supported by sentences [3]–[5].

choices.label: C
choices.text: Sentence [3], because it gives the first specific example.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Sentence [5], because it appears at the end of the paragraph.

exercises.explanation: 第[2]句概括说明学习效果更多取决于学习时间的使用方式，而第[3]至[5]句分别列举制订计划、关闭通知和复习要点等具体做法来支持这一观点。第[1]句只是引出一种常见看法，因此主题句不一定位于段首。

keypoints.title: 句法功能的含义
keypoints.body: 形容词主要作定语、表语和宾语补足语：作定语修饰名词，作表语说明主语特征或状态，作宾补说明宾语的特征或状态。

keypoints.title: 常见位置与搭配
keypoints.body: 形容词通常置于名词前作定语，置于be、look、feel、become等系动词后作表语，也可置于make、keep、find等动词后作宾语补足语。

exercises.stem: 观察句子：The tired students found the difficult exercise surprisingly easy. 下列说法正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: tired作表语，说明students的状态；easy作定语，修饰exercise。

choices.label: B
choices.text: difficult作宾语补足语，说明students的状态；easy作表语，说明exercise的状态。

choices.label: C
choices.text: tired和difficult均作定语，分别修饰students和exercise；easy作宾语补足语，说明exercise的状态。

choices.label: D
choices.text: tired、difficult和easy均作表语，分别说明三个名词的特征或状态。

exercises.explanation: tired位于名词students前，作定语；difficult位于名词exercise前，作定语。find后接宾语exercise和形容词easy，构成“find＋宾语＋形容词”，easy作宾语补足语，说明exercise的状态。

keypoints.title: 形容词通常按类别排列
keypoints.body: 多个形容词共同作名词前置定语时，通常按照较稳定的语义顺序排列：限定词或数量、观点、大小、年龄、形状、颜色、产地、材料、用途，最后是名词。

keypoints.title: 按语义类别确定顺序
keypoints.body: 先找出各形容词表达的意义类别，再依“观点—大小—年龄—形状—颜色—产地—材料—用途”排列。表示并列、地位相同的形容词，可用and或逗号连接。

exercises.stem: 下列短语中，形容词排列最符合通常语序的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: a lovely small old round French wooden coffee table

choices.label: B
choices.text: a lovely old small round French wooden coffee table

choices.label: C
choices.text: a French lovely small old round wooden coffee table

choices.label: D
choices.text: a lovely small round old wooden French coffee table

exercises.explanation: lovely表示观点，small表示大小，old表示年龄，round表示形状，French表示产地，wooden表示材料，coffee表示用途。通常顺序是“观点—大小—年龄—形状—产地—材料—用途—名词”，所以A正确。

keypoints.title: 副词位置随功能变化
keypoints.body: 频率副词通常放在实义动词前、be动词或助动词后；方式副词多放在动词或宾语后；地点副词常在时间副词前；程度副词通常放在被修饰词前；句子副词常置于句首或主语前后。

exercises.stem: 下列对句中副词的分类和位置判断，正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 在She often finishes her homework carefully at home after dinner.中，often是频率副词，通常置于实义动词finishes前；carefully是方式副词，置于宾语之后；地点短语at home位于时间状语after dinner之前。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 在He is often late.中，often是方式副词；频率副词通常应置于be动词前。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 在Fortunately, they arrived safely.中，Fortunately是方式副词，修饰arrived；safely是句子副词。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 在The water is extremely cold.中，extremely是句子副词，置于句首修饰整个句子。

exercises.explanation: often表示频率，通常放在实义动词前；carefully说明动作进行的方式，常放在动词或宾语后；at home表示地点，通常位于时间状语after dinner之前。B、C、D分别误判了副词的类别或位置。

keypoints.title: 比较结构表达差异
keypoints.body: 比较结构借助形容词或副词的原级、比较级、最高级及相应标记，表达两者相等、不同，或某个对象在三个及以上对象中程度最高或最低。

keypoints.title: 常见比较句式
keypoints.body: 同级：A＋be＋as＋原级＋as＋B；比较级：A＋be＋比较级＋than＋B；最高级：A＋be＋the＋最高级＋范围；也可用not as/so...as或less...than表示“不如”或“较不”。

exercises.stem: 要表达“这条路没有那条路宽”，下列句子正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: This road is not as wide as that one.

choices.label: B
choices.text: This road is not as wider as that one.

choices.label: C
choices.text: This road is as not wide as that one.

choices.label: D
choices.text: This road is less wider than that one.

exercises.explanation: 表示“……不如……”时，常用“not as/so＋形容词原级＋as”。因此应选“This road is not as wide as that one.”。B、D中比较级不能再与as或less构成这种错误搭配，C语序错误。

keypoints.title: 形容词和副词功能不同
keypoints.body: 形容词主要修饰名词或代词，也可作表语，说明人或事物的性质、状态；副词主要修饰动词、形容词、副词或句子，说明动作方式、程度、时间等。

keypoints.title: 注意系动词和词形
keypoints.body: 系动词后通常用形容词，如look happy；实义动词后说明动作方式时通常用副词，如speak slowly。good与well、hard与hardly、late与lately意义不同；以-ly结尾的词也不一定都是副词。

exercises.stem: 选择恰当的词完成句子：The children looked ___ after the long trip, but they walked ___ to the bus.

choices.label: A
choices.text: tired; slowly

choices.label: B
choices.text: tiredly; slow

choices.label: C
choices.text: tired; slow

choices.label: D
choices.text: tiredly; slowly

exercises.explanation: look在此处是系动词，后面用形容词tired作表语，说明孩子们的状态；walk是实义动词，说明走路的方式，后面用副词slowly修饰。因此选A。

keypoints.title: 概念与适用范围
keypoints.body: 比较级和最高级是形容词或副词表示不同程度的两种形式：比较级通常用于两者或两组比较，最高级通常用于三者或以上同类对象中程度最高或最低的比较。

keypoints.title: 规则与不规则变化
keypoints.body: 单音节及部分双音节词通常加-er/-est；以e结尾加-r/-st，以辅音字母+y结尾变y为i再加-er/-est，重读闭音节末尾单辅音字母通常双写；较长词多用more/most。常见不规则形式有good/well→better/best、bad/badly→worse/worst、many/much→more/most、little→less/least。

keypoints.title: 避免重复变化
keypoints.body: more/most不能与-er/-est同时使用，如more taller错误。最高级不是一律加-est：较长词通常用most，且应根据形容词或副词的词尾和重音选择正确形式。

exercises.stem: 下列形容词或副词的比较级和最高级变化形式正确的有（多选）：

choices.label: A
choices.text: happy → happier → happiest

choices.label: B
choices.text: large → largeer → largeest

choices.label: C
choices.text: big → bigger → biggest

choices.label: D
choices.text: beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful

choices.label: E
choices.text: good → gooder → goodest

exercises.explanation: happy以辅音字母加y结尾，变y为i后加-er、-est；big是重读闭音节词，词尾辅音字母要双写；beautiful较长，通常用more和most。large以e结尾应为larger、largest；good是不规则变化，应为better、best，不能写成gooder、goodest。

keypoints.title: 概念与作用
keypoints.body: 原因状语从句是在复合句中说明主句动作或状态原因的从句，通常由because、since、as等引导，并具有完整的主语和谓语。

keypoints.title: 常见引导结构
keypoints.body: because/since/as+原因从句可置于主句前或后：Because it rained, we stayed home. / We stayed home because it rained. 从句位于句首时，主从句之间通常用逗号；because通常直接、明确地说明原因。

keypoints.title: 区分because和because of
keypoints.body: because后接完整从句，because of后接名词、代词或动名词，二者不能直接混用。如because it rained正确，because of the rain正确。

exercises.stem:
选择能正确完成句子的选项：
___ the road was flooded, the buses were unable to leave the station.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Because

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because of

choices.label: C
choices.text: Despite

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because of that

exercises.explanation: 空格后是完整的原因从句“the road was flooded”，应使用because。because of后只能接名词、代词或动名词，因此不能接完整从句。由于原因状语从句位于句首，主句前用逗号隔开。

keypoints.title: 概念与作用
keypoints.body: 比较状语从句是在复合句中表示两者或两组在性质、程度或行为上相同、不同等比较关系的从句，常由as...as、than等引导。

keypoints.title: 常用比较结构
keypoints.body: 同等比较：主句+as+形容词或副词原级+as+从句；差异比较：主句+比较级+than+从句；否定同等：主句+not as/so+原级+as+从句。than或as后与主句重复的成分常可省略。

keypoints.title: 比较对象要对应
keypoints.body: 比较双方应属于同类并保持意义对应；more或less不能与-er或-est重复使用。not as...as表示程度不及或未达到同等，不表示两者完全相反。

exercises.stem: 选择语法正确且比较对象对应的句子：

choices.label: A
choices.text: Mia speaks English as fluently as her sister does.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Mia speaks English more fluently as her sister does.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Mia speaks English as more fluently as her sister does.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Mia speaks English as fluently than her sister does.

exercises.explanation: 表示同等比较时使用“as+副词原级+as”。“fluently”修饰speaks，as后用“her sister does”省略了与主句重复的speaks English。B把more fluently与as搭配，C在as...as中误加more，D误将as换成than，均不正确。

keypoints.title: 概念与作用
keypoints.body: 让步状语从句说明一个与主句事实或情况相对、相反或出乎预期的内容，表达“尽管……，但是……”的转折关系。

keypoints.title: 常见引导结构
keypoints.body: Although/Though/Even though+从句，主句；主句+although/though/even though+从句。若让步内容是假设而非事实，常用even if+从句，表示“即使……”。

keypoints.title: 避免重复转折
keypoints.body: although、though或even though不能与but在同一主从复合句中重复使用；despite或in spite of后接名词、代词或动名词，不能直接接完整从句。

exercises.stem: 选择能表达“尽管天气恶劣，但是比赛照常进行”且语法正确的句子：

choices.label: A
choices.text: Although the weather was bad, the match went on as planned.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Although the weather was bad, but the match went on as planned.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Despite the weather was bad, the match went on as planned.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because the weather was bad, the match went on as planned.

exercises.explanation: although引导让步状语从句，表示“尽管……”，后接完整从句，且不能与but在同一主从复合句中重复使用。despite后应接名词、代词或动名词，不能直接接完整从句；D表示原因，不符合题意。

keypoints.title: 表示条件或假设
keypoints.body: 条件状语从句说明主句动作发生的条件或假设情况，常由if、unless、as long as等引导，可放在主句前或后。例如：If it rains, we will stay home.

keypoints.title: 主从句时态有规律
keypoints.body: 表示将来条件时，条件从句通常用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时或祈使句、情态动词；不要在条件从句中直接用一般将来时表达将来条件。

exercises.stem: 用括号中动词的适当形式填空：If the traffic ______ (be) heavy tomorrow, we ______ (take) the subway.
exercises.explanation: 表示将来的条件时，if引导的条件状语从句通常用一般现在时，因此第一空填is；主句用一般将来时，第二空填will take。不能在if从句中直接使用will be。

keypoints.title: 省去重复成分
keypoints.body: 状语从句的省略，是在不影响理解时省去与主句重复的主语，或省去主语和be动词，保留分词、形容词等成分，如When young, she lived abroad。

keypoints.title: 用还原法检查
keypoints.body: 先找出从句的逻辑主语，再尝试补回与主句相同的主语和be动词。若主语不同，或省略后指代不清，就不能随意省略。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，状语从句省略正确且逻辑主语一致的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: When walking home, the rain suddenly started.

choices.label: B
choices.text: When young, she lived abroad.

choices.label: C
choices.text: While finished the work, he went out.

choices.label: D
choices.text: If invited to the party, the invitation was accepted by Tom.

exercises.explanation: B可还原为“When she was young, she lived abroad.”省略了与主句相同的主语she和be动词was。A中walking的逻辑主语应是人而不是the rain；C结构错误；D中invited的逻辑主语应是Tom，而主句主语却是the invitation，指代不一致。

keypoints.title: 说明动作方式
keypoints.body: 方式状语从句说明主句动作或状态以什么方式、样态发生，常由as、as if、as though等引导。例如：Do as I tell you。

keypoints.title: 表达按照或仿佛
keypoints.body: as常表示“按照……的方式”；as if和as though常表示“仿佛、好像”。从句需有相对完整的主语和谓语，具体时态根据表达的事实性和时间确定。

exercises.stem: 根据句意选择最佳选项：Tom spoke to the new student ______ he had known her for years.

choices.label: A
choices.text: as

choices.label: B
choices.text: as if

choices.label: C
choices.text: unless

choices.label: D
choices.text: so that

exercises.explanation: 句意为“汤姆和那位新同学说话，好像认识她很多年了”。as if表示“仿佛、好像”，后接完整的从句he had known her for years；as通常表示“按照……的方式”，不符合此处语意。

keypoints.title: 说明动作地点
keypoints.body: 地点状语从句说明主句动作发生的地点或范围，常由where、wherever等引导，可位于主句前或后。例如：Stay where you are。

keypoints.title: where与wherever有别
keypoints.body: where表示“在……的地方”，指向较明确的地点；wherever表示“无论哪里”，强调地点没有限制。例如：Wherever he goes, he makes friends。

exercises.stem: 选择能使句意和语法都正确的一组：Stay ___ you are; ___ the rescue team goes next, it will keep its radio on.

choices.label: A
choices.text: where；wherever

choices.label: B
choices.text: wherever；where

choices.label: C
choices.text: where；where

choices.label: D
choices.text: wherever；wherever

exercises.explanation: 第一空指听话人当前所在的明确地点，用 where；第二空表示救援队无论前往什么地方，用 wherever。两者都引导地点状语从句。

keypoints.title: 表示目的的从句
keypoints.body: 目的状语从句说明主句动作或状态所要达到的目的，通常由 so that 或 in order that 引导；从句本身具有完整的主语和谓语。

keypoints.title: 目的关系的表达
keypoints.body: 基本结构：主句＋so that/in order that＋从句。目的从句中常用 can、could、may、might、will 或 would 等情态动词，具体形式由语境决定。

exercises.stem: 选择正确选项：Mia wrote down the address carefully ___ she could find the office easily.

choices.label: A
choices.text: so that

choices.label: B
choices.text: in order to

choices.label: C
choices.text: because of

choices.label: D
choices.text: wherever

exercises.explanation: 句意是“米娅认真记下地址，以便她能轻松找到办公室”，表示目的，应使用 so that。其后接完整的目的状语从句 she could find the office easily；in order to 后通常接动词原形，不能直接引导完整从句。

keypoints.title: 表示结果的从句
keypoints.body: 结果状语从句说明主句动作或状态造成的结果，常由 so...that 或 such...that 引导；that 后接完整的从句。

keypoints.title: so与such的结构
keypoints.body: so＋形容词或副词＋that＋从句；such＋（形容词）＋名词＋that＋从句。单数可数名词前常用 such a/an＋形容词＋名词。

exercises.stem: 选择正确选项：The guide gave us ___ helpful advice that we avoided the mountain path.

choices.label: A
choices.text: so

choices.label: B
choices.text: such

choices.label: C
choices.text: such a

choices.label: D
choices.text: so a

exercises.explanation: advice 是不可数名词，结果状语从句的结构应为 such＋形容词＋名词＋that，因此用 such helpful advice。so 通常直接修饰形容词或副词，不能在此结构中直接修饰名词 advice；such a 只能用于单数可数名词。

keypoints.title: 表示时间关系
keypoints.body: 时间状语从句说明主句动作发生的时间、先后或持续情况，常由 when、while、before、after、until、as soon as 等引导。

keypoints.title: 注意时态呼应
keypoints.body: 当主句表示将来时，时间状语从句通常用一般现在时表示将来，不能直接用一般将来时。例如：I will call you when I arrive.

exercises.stem: 请选择能正确表达时态呼应的句子。

choices.label: A
choices.text: I will call you when I get to the station.

choices.label: B
choices.text: I will call you when I got to the station.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I will call you when I will get to the station.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I will call you when I had got to the station.

exercises.explanation: 主句使用一般将来时“I will call”，表示将来的时间状语从句通常用一般现在时表示将来，因此应使用“when I get to the station”。B和D使用了过去时态，C在时间状语从句中直接使用一般将来时，均不符合此处的时态呼应规则。

keypoints.title: as与which的用法
keypoints.body: as 和 which 可引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明前面的名词或整个主句；从句与先行内容之间通常用逗号隔开，不能限定先行词范围。

keypoints.title: 两者的使用差异
keypoints.body: as 常表示“正如”，可置于主句前、中、后，常见于 As is known...；which 多指前面已提到的名词或整件事，通常放在主句之后，二者不能随意互换。

exercises.stem: 选择最恰当的词填入句首：___ is often the case, students perform better when they are interested in the subject.

choices.label: A
choices.text: As

choices.label: B
choices.text: Which

choices.label: C
choices.text: What

choices.label: D
choices.text: That

exercises.explanation: “As is often the case”意为“正如通常的情况一样”，as引导非限制性定语从句，说明后面的整个主句，并且as可以置于主句之前。which通常指代前面已经提到的名词或整件事，通常位于主句之后，不能在本句句首替代as。What和that不能构成此处恰当的非限制性定语从句。

keypoints.title: 核心区别
keypoints.body: 定语从句修饰或限定先行词，关系词在从句中充当主语、宾语或状语等成分；同位语从句解释抽象名词的具体内容，典型的that只起连接作用，不充当从句成分。

keypoints.title: 判别方法
keypoints.body: 先看从句是在限定名词，还是在说明名词内容；再看关系词是否在从句中充当成分。前者是定语从句，后者是同位语从句。不要只因名词后出现that就作出判断。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，that引导的从句属于定语从句的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The fact that light travels faster than sound is well known.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The fact that he mentioned in class surprised us.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The news that the team had won delighted the fans.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The idea that we should leave early seemed reasonable.

exercises.explanation: B中“that he mentioned in class”修饰并限定“the fact”，且动词mentioned后缺少宾语，that在从句中充当mentioned的宾语，因此是定语从句。A、C、D中的从句本身结构完整，分别说明fact、news和idea的具体内容；其中that只起连接作用，不在从句中充当成分，属于同位语从句。

keypoints.title: 基本特征
keypoints.body: 非限制性定语从句对已明确的先行词作补充说明，不用于限定所指范围；书面语中通常与主句用逗号隔开，不能用that，关系代词也不能省略。

keypoints.title: 识别与使用
keypoints.body: 删去从句后，若先行词仍指向明确且主句意义基本完整，可考虑使用非限制性定语从句。连接词常用who、which、whom、whose、where或when，并注意用逗号隔开。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，非限制性定语从句的使用正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The Eiffel Tower, that attracts millions of visitors every year, is in Paris.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The Eiffel Tower which attracts millions of visitors every year, is in Paris.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The Eiffel Tower, which attracts millions of visitors every year, is in Paris.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The Eiffel Tower, attracts millions of visitors every year, which is in Paris.

exercises.explanation: “which attracts millions of visitors every year”是对已明确的先行词“The Eiffel Tower”的补充说明，属于非限制性定语从句，前后需用逗号隔开。非限制性定语从句不能用that，且不能缺少关系代词，因此C正确。

keypoints.title: 结构特点
keypoints.body: 介词+关系代词结构把从句中的介词置于关系代词之前，常见形式为介词+which或whom，整体在从句中表达介词关系，常用于较正式的表达。

keypoints.title: 构造方法
keypoints.body: 先还原普通句，找出动词、形容词或名词所要求的介词，再将介词放到which或whom前，如the person to whom I spoke。介词后不能直接用that，指人时正式表达通常用whom。

exercises.stem: 选择能构成正式、正确表达的选项：The professor ______ I discussed the plan praised the proposal.

choices.label: A
choices.text: with whom

choices.label: B
choices.text: with that

choices.label: C
choices.text: who

choices.label: D
choices.text: with which

exercises.explanation: “discuss sth with sb”表示“和某人讨论某事”，因此从句中需要介词with。介词置于关系代词前时，指人用whom，构成“with whom”；介词后不能用that，指人也不应使用which，所以A正确。

keypoints.title: 关系副词作用
keypoints.body: 关系副词when、where、why引导定语从句，分别表示时间、地点和原因，并在从句中作相应状语；其先行词通常是表示时间、地点或原因的名词。

keypoints.title: 选择与辨析
keypoints.body: 先判断从句缺少的是时间、地点还是原因状语，再选when、where或why；若缺少主语或宾语，应使用关系代词。地点、时间名词不一定搭配关系副词，要看其在从句中的实际作用。

exercises.stem: 选择最恰当的关系词：The laboratory ______ the students conduct their experiments is on the second floor.

choices.label: A
choices.text: which

choices.label: B
choices.text: where

choices.label: C
choices.text: when

choices.label: D
choices.text: why

exercises.explanation: 先行词“The laboratory”表示地点。从句“The students conduct their experiments”主谓宾成分完整，缺少的是地点状语，意为“学生们在实验室做实验”，因此用表示地点的关系副词where。which通常在从句中作主语或宾语，when表示时间，why表示原因。

keypoints.title: 关系代词的作用
keypoints.body: 关系代词引导定语从句，指代先行词，并在从句中充当主语、宾语或定语，整个从句修饰先行词。常见关系代词有who、whom、which、that和whose。

keypoints.title: 判断关系代词
keypoints.body: 先找先行词，再看它在从句中所作成分：指人作主语常用who或that，指物常用which或that；作宾语可用whom、who、which或that，表示所属用whose。

exercises.stem: 请选择正确的关系代词填空：The scientist ____ research changed the way we understand climate received an international award.

choices.label: A
choices.text: whose

choices.label: B
choices.text: whom

choices.label: C
choices.text: which

choices.label: D
choices.text: that

exercises.explanation: 先行词是指人的The scientist。从句中research与scientist之间是所属关系，表示“这位科学家的研究”，因此使用whose。

keypoints.title: 限制性从句的功能
keypoints.body: 限制性定语从句为先行词提供不可缺少的限定信息，用来明确所指对象；去掉后主句意思可能不完整或指向改变。书写时通常不加逗号。

keypoints.title: 关系代词的省略
keypoints.body: 先判断关系代词在从句中的成分：作宾语时可省略，如the book (that) I bought；作主语时不能省略。that可指人或物，但不能用于非限制性定语从句。

exercises.stem: 请选择能正确表达限制性定语从句的句子。

choices.label: A
choices.text: The documents that you submitted yesterday are on my desk.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The documents, that you submitted yesterday, are on my desk.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The documents who you submitted yesterday are on my desk.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The documents that you submitted yesterday is on my desk.

exercises.explanation: “你昨天提交的”是限定documents所必需的信息，属于限制性定语从句，通常不加逗号。that在从句中作submitted的宾语，可以使用；也可以省略。B错误地在限制性从句前后加逗号，that不能引导非限制性定语从句；C中先行词为物，不能用who；D中主句主语documents为复数，谓语应使用are。

keypoints.title: 并列关系的含义
keypoints.body: 表并列关系的并列句由and等并列连词连接两个或多个地位平等的分句，表示动作、事实或观点的并列、同时发生或相互补充。

keypoints.title: 并列句的连接
keypoints.body: 连接两个完整分句时，通常在and前加逗号；若前后主语相同，后分句可省略相同主语，但谓语结构必须清楚。并列成分的形式应尽量保持一致。

exercises.stem: 请选择使用and连接两个完整分句、表达并列关系的正确句子。

choices.label: A
choices.text: The volunteers cleaned the park, and they planted flowers along the path.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The volunteers cleaned the park and, they planted flowers along the path.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The volunteers cleaned the park, and planting flowers along the path.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The volunteers cleaned the park, they planted flowers along the path.

exercises.explanation: A中and连接两个完整分句，两个分句都有主语和过去式谓语，and前用逗号，表示两个动作的并列。B的逗号位置错误；C中and后是动名词短语，不能与前面的完整分句平行；D只有逗号连接两个完整分句，构成逗号拼接错误。

keypoints.title: 转折关系的含义
keypoints.body: 表转折关系的并列句由but、yet等并列连词连接两个地位平等的分句，表示后一分句的内容与前一分句相反、相对或出乎意料。

keypoints.title: but与however的区别
keypoints.body: but或yet连接两个完整分句时，前面通常用逗号；however是连接副词，不能像but一样仅用逗号连接两个独立分句，通常需用句号或分号等正确标点。

exercises.stem: 请选择转折关系和标点使用都正确的句子。

choices.label: A
choices.text: The task was difficult, but we completed it on time.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The task was difficult but, we completed it on time.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The task was difficult, however we completed it on time.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The task was difficult, however, we completed it on time.

exercises.explanation: A中but连接两个完整分句，前面用逗号，表示转折关系。However是连接副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个独立分句，因此C、D的标点不正确；B中逗号位置也不正确。

keypoints.title: 选择关系的含义
keypoints.body: 表选择关系的并列句由两个或多个地位平等的分句组成，表示在不同人、事物或行为中进行选择，提出两种或多种可能。常用并列连词or，也可用either...or...等结构。

keypoints.title: 常用表达结构
keypoints.body: 基本结构：分句A＋or＋分句B；强调两项选择时可用Either＋分句A＋or＋分句B。两部分通常在结构上保持对应，如都使用完整分句或相同形式。

exercises.stem: 请选择使用either...or...结构且两个选择在结构上保持对应的句子。

choices.label: A
choices.text: Either the students will present the project tomorrow, or they will submit a recorded presentation.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Either the students will present the project tomorrow, or submitting a recorded presentation.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Either the students will present the project tomorrow, and they will submit a recorded presentation.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Either the students present the project tomorrow, or they submitting a recorded presentation.

exercises.explanation: A用either...or...连接两个完整分句：Either the students will present...与they will submit...，结构对应，表示两种选择。B、D存在结构或语法错误，C使用and表示并列而不是选择。

keypoints.title: 因果关系的含义
keypoints.body: 表因果关系的并列句把两个地位平等的分句连接起来，说明原因与结果之间的关系。常用so表示“因此”，也可用for引出解释性原因。

keypoints.title: 常用因果结构
keypoints.body: 原因分句，so＋结果分句；结果分句，for＋原因分句。so或for连接两个独立分句时，通常在连词前加逗号。

keypoints.title: 避免重复使用因果词
keypoints.body: 不要在同一个因果结构中同时使用because和so，如不要说“Because…，so…”。because引导原因从句，so用于连接表示因果关系的并列分句。

exercises.stem: 请选择因果关系和标点使用都正确的句子。

choices.label: A
choices.text: The road was icy, so the driver slowed down.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because the road was icy, so the driver slowed down.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The road was icy so, the driver slowed down.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The road was icy, so because the driver slowed down.

exercises.explanation: A中两个完整分句由so连接，so前用逗号，表示“路面结冰，因此司机减速”。Because引导原因从句，不能与so在同一因果结构中重复使用；C的逗号位置错误，D重复使用因果表达且结构不当。

keypoints.title: 连接与过渡作用
keypoints.body: 连接副词和过渡词语用于连接句子或语篇中的意思，提示转折、因果、递进、顺序等逻辑关系，如however、therefore、moreover、then和in addition。它们通常不是并列连词。

keypoints.title: 正确连接两个分句
keypoints.body: 连接两个独立分句时，可用“分句A；连接副词，分句B”，也可分成两句。连接副词的位置可灵活调整，但标点和词语所表达的逻辑关系必须相符。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，使用连接副词正确连接两个独立分句的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The plan looked promising, however, the first trial failed.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The plan looked promising; however, the first trial failed.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The plan looked promising however; the first trial failed.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The plan looked promising; however the first trial failed.

exercises.explanation: however是连接副词，不是并列连词。连接两个独立分句时，应在前一分句后用分号，在however后用逗号，因此B正确。A用逗号连接两个独立分句，形成逗号拼接；C、D的标点位置不正确。

keypoints.title: 并列连词的含义
keypoints.body: 并列连词是连接两个或多个具有同等语法地位的词、短语或分句的词。常见的有and、but、or、so、for、nor、yet，可表达并列、转折、选择或因果等关系。

keypoints.title: 并列连接的结构
keypoints.body: 连接两个独立分句时，常用“分句A，＋并列连词＋分句B”；连接单词或短语时，一般直接使用并列连词，不在连词前加逗号。

exercises.stem: 句意为“雨停了，所以队员们回到了场上”。下列句子中，使用并列连词及标点正确的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The rain stopped, so the players returned to the field.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The rain stopped; so the players returned to the field.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The rain stopped so, the players returned to the field.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The rain stopped, the players returned to the field.

exercises.explanation: so是并列连词，表示因果关系。连接两个独立分句时，通常采用“分句A，so分句B”的结构，因此A正确。B在并列连词so前误用分号，C逗号位置错误，D只有逗号连接两个独立分句，属于逗号拼接。

keypoints.title: 关联连词的含义
keypoints.body: 关联连词由成对出现的词组成，用来连接两个地位相同、结构相似的成分或分句，表示并列、选择、转折等关系。常见形式有both...and、either...or、neither...nor、not only...but also。

keypoints.title: 正确使用关联结构
keypoints.body: 先根据语意选择恰当的关联词对，再检查两部分是否连接同类成分、结构是否平行。如连接主语，谓语形式通常要与主语保持一致；either...or和neither...nor连接主语时，谓语常与邻近主语一致。

exercises.stem: 根据句意和关联连词的平行结构填空：两者都没有批准修改后的日程安排。_____ the research assistants _____ the supervisor _____ approved the revised schedule.
exercises.explanation: 表示“两者都不”应使用关联连词neither...nor；the research assistants和the supervisor都是名词短语，结构平行。neither...nor连接不同数的主语时，谓语通常与邻近主语保持一致，邻近主语the supervisor为单数，所以用has。完整句为：Neither the research assistants nor the supervisor has approved the revised schedule.

keypoints.title: 从属连词的含义
keypoints.body: 从属连词用来引导从句，使从句成为主句的一个成分或附加说明，并表示时间、条件、原因、让步、目的等关系。常见词有when、if、because、although、so that。

keypoints.title: 判断从句关系
keypoints.body: 先找出主句和从句，再根据两者的逻辑关系选择连词。时间、条件等从句置于句首时，通常用逗号与主句分开；置于句末时一般不加逗号。

exercises.stem: 根据句意和标点规则，选择最恰当的一项： “当铃响时，学生们将离开教室。”

choices.label: A
choices.text: When the bell rings, the students will leave the room.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Because the bell rings, the students will leave the room.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Although the bell rings, the students will leave the room.

choices.label: D
choices.text: When the bell rings the students, will leave the room.

exercises.explanation: “当……时”表示时间关系，应使用从属连词when。when引导的时间从句位于句首时，通常用逗号与主句分开，因此A正确。because表示原因，although表示让步；D的逗号位置错误。

keypoints.title: 结构与基本含义
keypoints.body: 情态动词+have done表示对过去情况的推测、判断、责备或对过去行为的评价。基本结构为“情态动词+have+过去分词”，其中have不能改为has或had。

keypoints.title: 不同情态意义
keypoints.body: must have done表示对过去的肯定推测；may/might have done表示过去可能发生；can't/couldn't have done表示过去不可能；should/ought to have done常表示本应做却未做；needn't have done表示本无必要但已经做了。

exercises.stem: 根据语境选择最恰当的选项：Tom missed the meeting because he forgot to check the schedule. He ______ the schedule carefully.

choices.label: A
choices.text: should have checked

choices.label: B
choices.text: should checked

choices.label: C
choices.text: should has checked

choices.label: D
choices.text: should have check

exercises.explanation: 句意表明Tom过去本应该查看日程表，却没有这样做，应用should have done表示“本应该做而未做”。情态动词后用have，后接过去分词checked，不能用has、had或动词原形。

keypoints.title: 委婉表达的含义
keypoints.body: 情态动词的委婉用法借助较弱或较间接的形式提出请求、征求许可、表达意愿或建议，使语气更礼貌。此时过去式形式不一定表示过去时间，如Could you help me?

keypoints.title: 按场合选择形式
keypoints.body: 一般请求可用Could you...?或Would you...?；征求许可可用May I...?；表达意愿可用I would like to...。根据对象和场合调整语气，正式或陌生场合宜采用更委婉的表达。

exercises.stem: 你在第一次见面的教授的课上，想礼貌地请求提前离开。请选择最恰当的英文表达。

choices.label: A
choices.text: Must I leave early?

choices.label: B
choices.text: May I leave early, please?

choices.label: C
choices.text: I would like leave early.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Can you leave early?

exercises.explanation: 向对方征求许可时可用“May I...?”；在正式或与陌生人交流的场合，这种表达较为礼貌。A询问义务，D是请求对方离开，C缺少to，正确形式应为“I would like to leave early.”

keypoints.title: 含义与常见形式
keypoints.body: 表能力与许可的情态动词用于说明某人能否做某事，或某行为是否被允许。can最常见；could可表示过去能力，也可用于更委婉地请求或表达许可；may多用于较正式的许可。

keypoints.title: 基本句式
keypoints.body: 肯定句：主语+can/could/may+动词原形；否定句：cannot/can’t、couldn’t或may not+动词原形；疑问句将情态动词置于主语前。表达能力时，be able to可随时态变化。

exercises.stem: 选择能正确完成句子的选项：When Nina was four, she ___ read short English words.

choices.label: A
choices.text: could

choices.label: B
choices.text: may

choices.label: C
choices.text: must

choices.label: D
choices.text: should

exercises.explanation: 句意为“妮娜四岁时就能读简单的英语单词”。表示过去的能力用could，且情态动词后接动词原形read。may表示许可或可能，must表示必须或很有把握的推测，should表示应当，均不合适。

keypoints.title: 含义与强弱
keypoints.body: 这类情态动词或相关结构表示某行为必须、应当或有必要发生。must、have to表示较强义务或必要，should、ought to表示应当，need to表示需要；have to和need to是相关情态结构。

keypoints.title: 否定形式的区别
keypoints.body: mustn’t表示“禁止”，不是“不必”；“不必”用needn’t或don’t/doesn’t have to。表达过去的外部必要性通常用had to，而不能把must直接变为过去式。

exercises.stem: 选择能正确完成句子的选项：At this school, students ___ wear uniforms; they may choose their own clothes.

choices.label: A
choices.text: mustn't

choices.label: B
choices.text: don't have to

choices.label: C
choices.text: had to

choices.label: D
choices.text: should

exercises.explanation: 句意为“在这所学校，学生不必穿校服，他们可以选择自己的衣服”。don’t have to表示“不必、没有必要”；mustn’t表示“禁止”，不是“不必”。had to表示过去的必要，should表示“应当”，都不符合语境。

keypoints.title: 推测的确定程度
keypoints.body: 表推测与可能性的情态动词根据已有证据判断情况，而不是直接陈述事实。must表示很有把握，may、might、could表示有可能，can’t表示判断不可能。

keypoints.title: 现在与过去的推测
keypoints.body: 对现在或将来的推测常用“情态动词+动词原形”，如must be、may happen；对过去的推测用“情态动词+have+过去分词”，如must have left、may have forgotten。

exercises.stem: 选择能正确完成句子的选项：Leo isn't answering his phone. I am not sure where he is, but he ___ to the library.

choices.label: A
choices.text: may have gone

choices.label: B
choices.text: may go

choices.label: C
choices.text: must have gone

choices.label: D
choices.text: can't have gone

exercises.explanation: 说话人不确定Leo在哪里，表示对过去行为的可能性，应用“may + have + 过去分词”，所以选may have gone。may go表示现在或将来的可能；must have gone表示很有把握的过去推测；can’t have gone表示判断过去不可能发生。

keypoints.title: 结构与作用
keypoints.body: 独立主格结构（absolute construction）由带有自身逻辑主语的短语构成，整体通常作状语或补充说明。其逻辑主语一般不同于主句主语，常表达时间、原因、条件或伴随关系。

keypoints.title: 常见构成形式
keypoints.body: 常见形式为“名词或代词+doing/done”，也可接形容词或介词短语。名词与doing通常表示主动，名词与done通常表示被动或完成；结构常位于句首或句末，并用逗号与主句分隔。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，独立主格结构的构成和逻辑关系都正确，且能表达“由于主门已经关闭，游客从另一入口进入”的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The main gate having been closed, the visitors entered through another entrance.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The main gate having closed, the visitors entered through another entrance.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Having been closed, the visitors entered through another entrance.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The main gate having been closed, entering through another entrance.

exercises.explanation: A中“the main gate”是独立主格结构自身的逻辑主语，“having been closed”表示主门已经被关闭，主句主语“the visitors”与其不同，结构和逻辑关系正确。B中的closed使用主动形式，不能准确表达主门“被关闭”；C中having been closed的逻辑主语错误地指向了visitors；D的主句缺少谓语动词。

keypoints.title: 动名词是什么
keypoints.body: 动名词是动词的-ing形式，在句中主要当名词使用，可表示一个动作或行为；它仍可带宾语、状语等动词成分。例如，Reading books is useful中Reading books作主语。

keypoints.title: 判断句法功能
keypoints.body: 看动名词短语在句中的位置和作用：位于谓语前可作主语，位于及物动词或介词后可作宾语，系动词后可作表语；置于名词前时可作定语，表示用途或功能，如a swimming pool。

exercises.stem: 下列对句中括号部分的句法功能判断正确的是（多选）：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 【Reading novels before bed】 relaxes me. —— 作主语

choices.label: B
choices.text: She avoided 【answering the question】. —— 作动词avoided的宾语

choices.label: C
choices.text: They are interested in 【learning languages】. —— 作介词in的宾语

choices.label: D
choices.text: Her favorite activity is 【swimming】. —— 作定语

exercises.explanation: A中动名词短语位于谓语relaxes之前，作主语；B中answering the question位于及物动词avoided之后，作宾语；C中learning languages位于介词in之后，作介词宾语。D中swimming位于系动词is之后，说明activity的内容，作表语而不是定语。

keypoints.title: 选用的依据
keypoints.body: 动名词和不定式都能作非谓语成分，但不能随意互换。选用形式主要由谓语动词、固定搭配和表达的时间或意义决定。

keypoints.title: 三步判断
keypoints.body: 先查谓语动词的搭配要求，再看是否有介词（介词后通常用动名词），最后辨析意义：stop doing指停止某事，stop to do指停下来去做另一事；remember doing指记得做过，remember to do指记得去做。

exercises.stem:
根据语境，用括号内动词的适当形式填空，并说明每空表达的意义：
After three hours of continuous writing, Emma stopped ___ (write) and went out for a walk. Before leaving home, she remembered ___ (turn off) the stove. Later, she remembered ___ (meet) her former teacher at the station.
exercises.explanation: 第一空用writing，stop doing表示停止正在做的事情；第二空用to turn off，remember to do表示记得去做某事，动作尚未发生或发生在“记得”之后；第三空用meeting，remember doing表示记得做过某事，强调回忆过去的经历。

keypoints.title: 不定式的句法作用
keypoints.body: 动词不定式通常由to+动词原形构成，也有省略to的形式；它保留动词意义，却可在句中充当名词、定语或状语等成分，常见功能有主语、宾语、表语、宾语补足语、定语和状语。

keypoints.title: 按位置识别
keypoints.body: 谓语前或It作形式主语时，不定式可作主语；动词后可作宾语，系动词后可作表语；名词后常作定语，说明用途或将要发生的动作；置于句末常作目的、结果等状语。使役动词和感官动词后常用省略to的不定式作宾补。

exercises.stem: 在句子“The teacher encouraged the students [to ask questions] after class.”中，方括号内的不定式短语充当什么成分？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 主语

choices.label: B
choices.text: 宾语

choices.label: C
choices.text: 宾语补足语

choices.label: D
choices.text: 目的状语

exercises.explanation: “to ask questions”位于宾语“the students”之后，补充说明教师鼓励学生做什么，结构为“encourage sb. to do sth.”，因此充当宾语补足语。

keypoints.title: 时态与语态的含义
keypoints.body: 不定式没有人称和数的变化，其形式所表示的时间通常是相对于谓语动作的先后关系；语态表示不定式逻辑主语与动作的主动或被动关系。

keypoints.title: 常见构成与意义
keypoints.body: 一般式：to do（与谓语同时或随后）；完成式：to have done（先于谓语）；进行式：to be doing（表示进行）；被动式：to be done；完成被动式：to have been done。需表达完成进行时，可用to have been doing。

keypoints.title: 不要按主句变形
keypoints.body: 不要把不定式像谓语一样按主语改成to does、to did或to be did。先判断动作相对谓语的先后，再判断逻辑主语是否承受动作：主动用to do或to have done，被动用to be done或to have been done。

exercises.stem: 选择能正确完成句子的选项：The missing files are believed ___ before the computer crashed.

choices.label: A
choices.text: to delete

choices.label: B
choices.text: to be deleted

choices.label: C
choices.text: to have deleted

choices.label: D
choices.text: to have been deleted

exercises.explanation: “files”是“删除”这一动作的承受者，应用被动形式；删除发生在电脑崩溃之前，先于主句“are believed”所表达的判断，因此使用完成被动式“to have been deleted”。

keypoints.title: 逻辑主语是什么
keypoints.body: 非谓语动词所表示动作或状态的实际执行者或承受者，称为逻辑主语。它不一定在形式上充当主语，通常由主句主语、非谓语前的名词或“for＋名词/代词”结构确定。

keypoints.title: 判断逻辑主语
keypoints.body: 先还原非谓语的动作，再问“谁做”或“谁被……”。若与主句主语一致，常直接使用非谓语；若不一致，应明确写出其逻辑主语，并检查主动或被动关系，避免出现悬垂结构。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，非谓语短语的逻辑主语明确且符合语义的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: Having finished the experiment, the results were recorded by Lin.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Having finished the experiment, Lin recorded the results.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Having finished the experiment, the lab was cleaned by Lin.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Having finished the experiment, the report seemed accurate.

exercises.explanation: “Having finished the experiment”的逻辑主语是实验的完成者。B句中主句主语“Lin”正是完成实验的人，逻辑主语一致。A、C、D中的主语分别是“results”“lab”“report”，都不能合理地完成实验，属于逻辑主语不当或悬垂结构。

keypoints.title: 过去分词的作用
keypoints.body: 过去分词通常为-ed形式或不规则形式，可作定语、表语或状语。它常带有被动或完成意味：定语修饰名词，表语说明主语状态，状语补充时间、原因、条件、让步等信息。

keypoints.title: 三种用法的特点
keypoints.body: 过去分词作状语时，其逻辑主语通常是主句主语，并与主句主语构成被动或状态关系；作定语时可前置或带修饰语后置；作表语时常位于be等系动词之后。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，括号内的过去分词短语作状语的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The (damaged) bridge was repaired yesterday.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The students felt (disappointed) after the game.

choices.label: C
choices.text: (Surrounded by trees), the house looks peaceful.

choices.label: D
choices.text: We received the parcels (delivered this morning).

exercises.explanation: C中“Surrounded by trees”位于句首，补充说明主句情况，作状语；其逻辑主语是the house，表示房子处于“被树木环绕”的状态。A和D中的过去分词修饰名词，作定语；B中的过去分词位于系动词felt之后，说明主语状态，作表语。

keypoints.title: 现在分词的作用
keypoints.body: 现在分词是动词的-ing形式。作定语时修饰名词，通常表示主动、进行或某种特征；作状语时修饰主句谓语，可表示同时、先后、原因、条件或结果等关系。

keypoints.title: 辨别定语与状语
keypoints.body: 看-ing短语所修饰的对象：紧邻名词并说明名词特征，多为定语；位于句首、句中或句末并补充主句信息，多为状语。作状语时，其逻辑主语通常与主句主语一致。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，括号内的现在分词短语作状语，且其逻辑主语与主句主语一致的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The woman (waiting outside) is our new manager.

choices.label: B
choices.text: (Walking through the park), I found a small bookstore.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The children (playing in the yard) waved to us.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The (shining) stars filled the sky.

exercises.explanation: B中“Walking through the park”位于句首，补充说明主句动作发生时的伴随情况，作状语；其逻辑主语是主句主语I。A、C、D中的现在分词短语都紧邻名词并修饰名词，作定语。

keypoints.title: 同位语从句是什么
keypoints.body: 同位语从句是跟在某些抽象名词后、用完整句子说明该名词具体内容的从句。常见名词有fact、news、idea、hope、possibility等，可由that、whether、how、when等引导。

keypoints.title: 与定语从句的区别
keypoints.body: 两者都可位于名词之后，但同位语从句解释名词的内容，名词与从句可理解为“内容相同”；定语从句修饰或限定名词，关系词通常在从句中充当主语、宾语等成分。判断时先看从句成分是否完整。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，that引导的从句属于同位语从句的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: The news that our team had won surprised everyone.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The news that arrived this morning surprised everyone.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The news which arrived this morning surprised everyone.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The idea that she suggested was discussed at the meeting.

exercises.explanation: A中“our team had won”本身成分完整，that引导的从句具体说明news的内容，news与从句表达的内容可以理解为同一件事，因此是同位语从句。B、C中关系词在从句中作主语，D中that在“she suggested”中作宾语，三者都是定语从句。

keypoints.title: 引导词的作用
keypoints.body: 名词性从句的引导词选择，是依据从句在句中的成分作用和所表达的意思，确定that、whether/if、疑问词或复合疑问词等连接形式。

keypoints.title: 按功能选择引导词
keypoints.body: 先看从句是否缺少主语、宾语、表语或状语：不缺成分且只表陈述用that；表“是否”用whether/if；缺成分或需表达疑问意义用who、what、which、when、where、why、how等。介词后或与or not连用时优先用whether。

exercises.stem: 请选择最恰当的引导词填入空格：No one could explain ___ the lights went out during the performance.

choices.label: A
choices.text: that

choices.label: B
choices.text: whether

choices.label: C
choices.text: why

choices.label: D
choices.text: which

exercises.explanation: “the lights went out”成分完整，但句意是在询问停电的原因，因此用表示“为什么”的why引导宾语从句。that只表示陈述，whether表示“是否”，which表示“哪一个”。

keypoints.title: 语序与时态规则
keypoints.body: 名词性从句使用陈述句语序，即主语在前、谓语在后；时态根据主句时态、主从句动作的先后关系以及是否表达客观事实等确定。

keypoints.title: 时态要看语境
keypoints.body: 主句为过去时，从句时态常相应后移：一般现在时变一般过去时，现在进行时变过去进行时，现在完成时变过去完成时；客观事实、自然规律仍用一般现在时。

exercises.stem: 请选择能使句子同时符合名词性从句语序和时态规则的一项：Yesterday, the teacher asked us ___ around the Sun and reminded us that this fact remains true today.

choices.label: A
choices.text: whether did the Earth move

choices.label: B
choices.text: whether the Earth moved

choices.label: C
choices.text: whether the Earth moves

choices.label: D
choices.text: that the Earth moves

exercises.explanation: whether引导的宾语从句要使用陈述句语序，即“the Earth”在前、“moves”在后。地球绕太阳运行是客观事实，虽主句为过去时，从句仍用一般现在时，因此选C。

keypoints.title: 宾语从句的定义
keypoints.body: 宾语从句是在复合句中充当动词或介词等宾语的从句，常由that、whether/if或疑问词引导，整体在句中作宾语。

keypoints.title: 识别与使用步骤
keypoints.body: 先找主句谓语，再问“什么、谁、是否、何时”等；若后面的分句回答这些问题，通常就是宾语从句。引导词后用陈述语序；that在适当情况下可省略，whether/if和疑问词不能随意省略。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，方括号内的从句充当动词宾语的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: [What she said] was true.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The day [when we first met] is unforgettable.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I wonder [whether the shop is open].

choices.label: D
choices.text: The question is [where we should meet].

exercises.explanation: C中whether引导的从句作动词wonder的宾语，回答“想知道什么”。A中的从句作主语，B中的从句修饰名词day，D中的从句作表语。

keypoints.title: 表语从句的定义
keypoints.body: 表语从句是置于系动词之后、充当表语的从句，用来说明主语的身份、性质、状态、原因或结果。

keypoints.title: 与其他从句辨析
keypoints.body: 表语从句与主语从句、宾语从句同属名词性从句；区别在于它跟在系动词后说明主语，如“The problem is that we are late.”，而不是充当动词宾语。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，方括号内的从句属于表语从句的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: [What he said] surprised everyone.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The truth is [that nobody has found the lost key].

choices.label: C
choices.text: I wonder [whether she will come tomorrow].

choices.label: D
choices.text: [Why he left] remains unknown.

exercises.explanation: B中从句that nobody has found the lost key位于系动词is之后，说明主语The truth的具体内容，充当表语，因此是表语从句。A和D中的从句充当主语，C中的从句充当动词wonder的宾语。

keypoints.title: 主语从句的含义
keypoints.body: 主语从句是在复合句中充当主语的完整从句，整体相当于一个名词。常由 that、whether 或疑问词引导，可置于谓语前，也可用 it 作形式主语，将从句后置。

keypoints.title: 识别与使用方法
keypoints.body: 识别时先找主句谓语，再判断哪个从句整体回答“什么”或“谁”。从句内部用陈述语序，如 What he needs is...，不能写成 What does he need is...。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，主语从句使用正确且从句采用陈述语序的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: What does he need is a quiet place.

choices.label: B
choices.text: What he needs is a quiet place.

choices.label: C
choices.text: What he needs a quiet place is.

choices.label: D
choices.text: What he need is a quiet place.

exercises.explanation: B中What he needs是主语从句，整体作句子的主语；从句内部使用陈述语序what he needs，而不是疑问语序what does he need。need与主语he保持第三人称单数形式，使用needs。

keypoints.title: 抽象名词具体化
keypoints.body: 抽象名词具体化是指表示性质、状态、情感等概念的名词，在特定语境中转而指一个具体的人、事物、事件、经历或表现。此时它可按可数名词使用。

keypoints.title: 具体化后的形式
keypoints.body: 具体化后可与 a/an 连用或有复数形式。例如 success 表示“成功”时通常不可数，a success 可指“一件成功的事”或“一个成功者”，successes 可指多次成功或不同成果。是否具体化取决于词义和语境。

exercises.stem:
选择恰当的选项完成句子：
The new school play was ___; even the usually strict judges gave it high praise.

choices.label: A
choices.text: a success

choices.label: B
choices.text: success

choices.label: C
choices.text: successes

choices.label: D
choices.text: a successful

exercises.explanation: 句中school play指一场具体的演出，success表示“一件成功的事情”，已由抽象名词具体化为可数名词，因此前面要用不定冠词a。success作“成功”这一抽象概念时通常不可数；D中successful是形容词，不能直接放在was后作名词表语。

keypoints.title: 两类名词的区别
keypoints.body: 可数名词表示能按一个、两个等数出个体的事物，有单复数之分；不可数名词通常表示物质、整体、概念或难以逐个计数的事物，一般没有普通复数形式，不能直接用 a/an。

keypoints.title: 名词搭配的选择
keypoints.body: 单数可数名词通常要有限定词，复数可与 many、few 等连用；不可数名词常与 much、little 等连用，数量可用 a piece of、a bottle of 等单位表达。选用谓语和限定词要先判断名词在句中的实际含义。

exercises.stem: 请选出能使句子语法和语义都正确的一项：There isn't ___ useful information in the report, but there are ___ clear examples.

choices.label: A
choices.text: many; much

choices.label: B
choices.text: much; many

choices.label: C
choices.text: a; much

choices.label: D
choices.text: an; a lot

exercises.explanation: information 通常是不可数名词，不能用 many，也不能直接用 a/an，应使用 much；examples 是可数名词的复数形式，可与 many 搭配。因此选 B。

keypoints.title: 定冠词的作用
keypoints.body: 定冠词 the 用来指明特定的人或事物，使听者或读者能够确定所指对象。它可用于单数、复数可数名词以及不可数名词之前。

keypoints.title: 常见使用情境
keypoints.body: 名词已提及、语境中唯一、被短语或从句限定，或带序数词、形容词最高级时，通常用 the，如 the book on the desk、the first day、the best answer。

keypoints.title: 避免泛指误用
keypoints.body: 表示一类事物的一般意义时，复数可数名词或不可数名词通常不用 the；若语境限定为特定范围，则应使用 the。不要把“名词前有形容词”误当作必用 the 的依据。

exercises.stem: 下列句子中，空格处应填入定冠词 the 的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: ___ interesting books can broaden one's mind.

choices.label: B
choices.text: ___ fresh air is important for good health.

choices.label: C
choices.text: ___ books on the top shelf belong to the history department.

choices.label: D
choices.text: ___ patience is needed when learning a language.

exercises.explanation: C 中的 books 被介词短语 on the top shelf 限定，指书架顶层的特定书籍，因此用 the。A 的复数名词泛指一类书，B 和 D 的不可数名词也表示一般概念，通常不用 the。

keypoints.title: 基本含义
keypoints.body: 不定冠词 a 和 an 放在单数可数名词前，表示某一类中的“一个”，但不说明具体是哪一个。用 a 还是 an 取决于后面词的起始发音，而不是字母。

keypoints.title: 选择与使用
keypoints.body: 先确认名词是单数可数名词；以辅音音素开头用 a，如 a book、a university；以元音音素开头用 an，如 an apple、an hour。首次提到的人或物、职业身份前也常用不定冠词。

exercises.stem: 选择正确的一组冠词：At the career fair, Chen spoke with ___ engineer from ___ European university and then waited for ___ hour to meet ___ HR manager.

choices.label: A
choices.text: an; an; a; a

choices.label: B
choices.text: a; an; an; an

choices.label: C
choices.text: an; a; an; an

choices.label: D
choices.text: a; a; an; a
