choices.text: 先说阅读很重要，然后不分顺序地列出许多观点，不使用连接词，也不提供任何解释或例子。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 先明确表达自己的观点；接着用 First、Moreover 等连接词分述阅读有助于扩大词汇量和形成深入思考，并分别给出例子；最后用 Therefore 概括结论。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 先给出结论，再把所有理由混在一起；用 However 连接彼此并不构成转折的句子，并根据个人想法不断改变话题。

exercises.explanation: 连贯陈述需要围绕明确主题和目的组织完整内容。C采用总述—分述—总结的结构，理由之间层次清楚，例子使观点具体，并使用了意义恰当的连接词。A、B、D分别存在偏离主题、缺少逻辑组织或连接词使用不当的问题。

keypoints.title: 多模态信息整合
keypoints.body: 整合多模态信息，是综合文字、图像、声音、符号、版式等不同表达方式中的信息，判断它们之间的关系，形成对语篇主题和细节的整体理解。

keypoints.title: 互证信息再概括
keypoints.body: 先分别提取各模态的关键信息，再比较、联系和互相验证；区分直接呈现的信息与根据线索作出的推断，最后用简洁语言概括共同指向的意义。

exercises.stem:
Read the school poster and listen to the audio announcement.

Poster: At the top, it says “REFILL, DON’T LANDFILL!” The central picture shows a reusable bottle beside a pile of discarded plastic cups, with a green arrow pointing from the bottle to a water tap. At the bottom, the poster says, “Bring your own bottle. Refill at the Library or Gym.”

Audio announcement: “From next Monday, the cafeteria will no longer sell single-use bottled water. Students can fill reusable bottles at the stations by the library and gym. During the first week, eco-club members will count refills to see how many bottles are avoided.”

Which statement best summarizes the message conveyed by both the poster and the announcement?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The school is encouraging students to use reusable bottles and refill stations instead of single-use bottled water.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The eco-club will install new water stations in the cafeteria and library next Monday.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Students must buy reusable bottles from the cafeteria and report every refill.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The campaign mainly asks students to reduce their access to drinking water.

exercises.explanation: The poster uses the image of a reusable bottle, discarded cups, and a water tap to promote refilling rather than using disposable containers. The announcement adds the cafeteria rule and identifies the refill stations. Although the poster and announcement present information in different modes, they point to the same overall message: students should use reusable bottles and refill them instead of buying single-use bottled water.

keypoints.title: 图表数据解读
keypoints.body: 解读图表数据，是根据标题、图例、坐标、单位和数据内容，准确获取数量关系，并分析比较、变化趋势或分布特点，得出有依据的结论。

keypoints.title: 读要素找关系
keypoints.body: 先确认图表主题、时间范围和计量单位，再读取关键数据；通过比较大小、计算差值或观察升降趋势提炼规律，陈述结论时引用数据作为依据。

exercises.stem:
Read the line-chart data below.

Title: Preferred Ways Senior Students Travel to School, 2022–2025
Unit: Percentage (%) of surveyed students
Legend: Bicycle; Bus

Year:      2022   2023   2024   2025
Bicycle:     18     22     29     35
Bus:         46     44     41     38

Which conclusion is best supported by the data?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Bicycle use rose by 17 percentage points, while bus use fell by 8 percentage points; bus remained more popular in 2025.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Bicycle use became higher than bus use in 2024.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Bus use increased every year, especially from 2024 to 2025.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The number of students who cycled exactly doubled from 2022 to 2025.

exercises.explanation: Bicycle use increased from 18% to 35%, a rise of 17 percentage points. Bus use decreased from 46% to 38%, a fall of 8 percentage points. In 2025, bus use at 38% was still higher than bicycle use at 35%. The chart gives percentages rather than the actual number of students, so D is not supported.

keypoints.title: 图示与流程图的含义
keypoints.body: 解读图示与流程图，是借助图形、文字、线条、箭头和符号等视觉信息，识别事物的结构、步骤、顺序、条件及相互关系，并概括其核心信息。

keypoints.title: 按关系和顺序解读
keypoints.body: 先看标题、图例和整体结构，再确定流程的起点与终点；沿箭头逐步阅读，区分步骤、判断条件和结果，最后用简洁语言复述过程或说明关系。

exercises.stem:
Study the flowchart.

Title: How a Student Club Proposal Is Processed

[Start] → Draft proposal → Submit online → [Are all required sections complete?]
• No → Complete missing sections → Submit online
• Yes → Student council review → [Is the proposal approved?]
　　　• Yes → Publish proposal → [End]
　　　• No → Read feedback → Revise proposal → Submit online

A student submits a proposal with all required sections complete, but the student council does not approve it. Which route should the proposal follow?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Draft proposal → Submit online → Complete missing sections → Submit online → Publish proposal

choices.label: B
choices.text: Draft proposal → Submit online → Student council review → Read feedback → Revise proposal → Submit online again

choices.label: C
choices.text: Draft proposal → Submit online → Read feedback → Publish proposal

choices.label: D
choices.text: Draft proposal → Complete missing sections → Student council review → End

exercises.explanation: Because all required sections are complete, the process follows the “Yes” branch to student council review. Since the proposal is not approved, it follows the “No” branch: read the feedback, revise the proposal, and submit it online again. The other options either use the wrong condition or omit a required step.

keypoints.title: 影视动画语篇
keypoints.body: 影视与动画语篇是综合画面、人物动作、对白、旁白、字幕、音乐和音响等多种符号表达意义的语篇。理解时要把语言信息与视听信息结合起来，把握情节、人物和主题。

keypoints.title: 结合视听信息理解
keypoints.body: 观看时先判断场景、人物和事件，再结合对白、表情、动作、镜头、音乐及字幕推断人物关系、情感和情节发展；观看后概括主要内容，并说明主题或寓意。

exercises.stem: 观看一段约45秒的无对白动画：雨天的公交站，一名男孩低头看手机，背景音乐轻快。一位老人拎着菜袋站在雨中，男孩抬头看了看老人，音乐随之变得舒缓。站牌特写显示“末班车还有1分钟”，男孩又看向驶来的公交车，随后把伞递给老人，自己跑向另一条路。下一镜头中，男孩在另一站等车，手表显示晚了20分钟；老人上车前回头向他挥手。片尾字幕为“Sometimes, kindness changes your way home.” Which interpretation is best supported by all the visual, auditory and verbal cues?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The boy misses the bus by accident and becomes angry with the old woman.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The boy chooses to help the old woman, accepting some inconvenience and showing that kindness can change one’s original plan.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The old woman is testing whether the boy can read the bus timetable.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The boy changes buses because he is afraid of travelling in the rain.

exercises.explanation: 男孩注意到老人在雨中，音乐由轻快转为舒缓，随后主动递伞并改变等车地点，说明他有意识地选择帮助老人。老人挥手和片尾字幕进一步强调：善意可能使人改变原来的行程，但这种改变具有积极意义。

keypoints.title: 图像符号与色彩
keypoints.body: 解读图片、符号与色彩，是根据画面中的对象、形状、位置、符号特征和色彩作用，结合语境推断其所传达的事实、情感、态度或提示信息。

keypoints.title: 从观察到推断
keypoints.body: 先描述看见的对象和视觉特征，再分析符号、色彩及构图之间的关系，结合文字和使用场景判断其含义；注意同一色彩或符号在不同语境中可能有不同作用。

exercises.stem: At the entrance to a school library, a poster has a blue background. In the center is a bright yellow open book. Above it, a white ear is placed beside a finger at the lips. On the right, a mobile-phone icon is covered by a red diagonal line. The words below say, “QUIET MINDS, DEEPER READING.” Which interpretation best explains how the visual elements work together in this context?

choices.label: A
choices.text: The calm blue background and bright book focus attention on reading, while the quiet gesture and crossed-out phone ask students to reduce noise and put phones away.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The red line shows that the library is closed, and the yellow book warns students not to borrow books.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The blue background means that only digital books may be used in the library.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The ear and phone icons advertise a service for repairing mobile phones in the library.

exercises.explanation: 蓝色营造安静、平和的氛围，明亮的黄色书本成为视觉焦点；手指放在嘴边表示保持安静，手机上的红色斜线表示禁止或避免使用手机。结合图中文字和学校图书馆场景，海报是在提醒学生安静阅读并收起手机。

keypoints.title: 论点的基本含义
keypoints.body: 论点是针对某个问题或现象提出的明确主张，是议论文章希望读者接受的核心观点。它应立场清楚、表述完整，具有一定的讨论价值，并能由材料和理由支持。

keypoints.title: 明确主张再表述
keypoints.body: 先审清话题和写作任务，确定自己的立场；再围绕对象、态度和理由组织成完整句子，限定适用范围，避免只写现象、口号或宽泛的主题。

keypoints.title: 避免把话题当论点
keypoints.body: 话题只是讨论的对象，如“网络阅读”；论点必须表达明确判断，如“合理安排网络阅读有助于拓展知识”。不能用材料、事实或没有立场的叙述代替论点。

exercises.stem: Some people believe that schools should reduce printed homework and use digital tasks instead. Which sentence is the most suitable thesis for an argumentative essay on this issue?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Digital learning.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Homework is important for students.

choices.label: C
choices.text: To reduce paper waste without weakening practice, schools should replace some routine printed homework with well-designed digital tasks while keeping non-digital options for students with limited access.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Many schools use both computers and paper for homework.

exercises.explanation: C明确提出了立场，即用设计合理的数字任务替代部分重复性纸质作业，同时考虑设备或网络条件有限的学生；它还限定了适用范围并给出可讨论的理由。A只是话题，D是事实描述，B虽有判断但过于宽泛，均不适合作为该题的核心论点。

keypoints.title: 说明事物与阐释事理
keypoints.body: 说明事物是介绍对象的名称、特征、功能、分类等，使读者了解“是什么”；阐释事理是解释现象、原因、规律、关系或作用，使读者明白“为什么”和“怎样”。

keypoints.title: 按逻辑组织说明
keypoints.body: 先明确说明对象或要解释的问题，再根据内容选择分类、列举、比较、因果等方式，按由整体到局部、由现象到本质或由原因到结果的顺序展开，做到信息准确、层次清楚。

exercises.stem: 学校英文校刊准备刊登一段题为“Why do short breaks improve study efficiency?”的说明性文字。以下哪一段最符合“阐释事理”的要求，并且按“现象—原因—结果”的逻辑展开？

choices.label: A
choices.text: A short break is a brief period of rest during study. It may include walking, drinking water, or looking out of the window.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Students should take short breaks because they are useful. In my opinion, every student must follow this advice.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Many students find that a five-minute break helps them return to a difficult task with more attention. This is because a brief pause reduces mental fatigue and gives the brain time to reorganize information. As a result, students can work more accurately when they resume studying.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A short break is useful for study. Students may take one after finishing a task, and it can include several relaxing activities. It is also a good choice for many students.

exercises.explanation: A主要介绍短暂休息“是什么”和包括哪些活动，属于说明事物；B只是表达主张，缺少解释；D罗列特点和作用，没有说明作用产生的原因。C先写学生的学习现象，再解释短暂休息如何减轻疲劳、整理信息，最后说明由此产生的学习效果，符合由现象到原因再到结果的阐释顺序。

keypoints.title: 论证方法的含义
keypoints.body: 论证方法是运用论据证明观点、增强说服力的具体方式。常见方法有举例论证、道理论证、对比论证和比喻论证等，不同方法承担的证明作用不同。

keypoints.title: 选择合适的论证方法
keypoints.body: 先明确分论点，再选择相匹配的方法：事实材料适合举例，原理名言适合说理，正反材料适合对比，熟悉事物与抽象道理之间可用比喻。论据后要补充分析，说明其如何支持观点。

exercises.stem: 阅读下面的英文议论文片段，判断其中主要使用的论证方法。Reading news regularly can strengthen students' critical thinking. For example, in our class, students examined two reports about school uniforms. They listed the evidence in each report and found that the reports reached different conclusions. After the activity, more students began asking what supported each claim. This classroom experience shows that news reading gives students practice in checking claims instead of accepting them immediately.

choices.label: A
choices.text: 道理论证

choices.label: B
choices.text: 对比论证

choices.label: C
choices.text: 举例论证

choices.label: D
choices.text: 比喻论证

exercises.explanation: 片段用本班学生分析两篇报道的具体课堂经历来证明“经常阅读新闻能增强批判性思维”，并在事例后说明该经历如何支持观点，因此主要是举例论证。报道结论不同只是事例中的内容，并非全文主要通过正反材料对比来证明观点；文中也没有引用原理或使用比喻。

keypoints.title: 组织论据的含义
keypoints.body: 组织论据是围绕中心论点筛选、安排并分析事实或道理论据，使各项材料与观点形成清晰、严密的证明关系。

keypoints.title: 构建论据链
keypoints.body: 先确定中心论点和分论点，再筛选真实、典型、相关的材料；按重要性、时间顺序或逻辑关系排列；每段围绕一个分论点展开，并用分析句说明论据为何能够支持观点。

exercises.stem: 中心论点是：The school should establish a weekly reading-sharing session. 分论点是：A fixed, peer-supported activity helps students develop a regular reading habit. 下面四句英文材料均可使用。选择最能形成“现状证据—行动结果—分析—回扣观点”论据链的排列顺序。① In a survey of 120 students, 78% reported that they did not read on a fixed schedule. ② During a four-week pilot, the 60 students who joined a weekly reading-sharing session increased their average reading days from two to four per week. ③ This improvement suggests that a fixed time and peer recommendations make reading easier to continue. ④ Therefore, our school should establish the session for more students.

choices.label: A
choices.text: ①—②—③—④

choices.label: B
choices.text: ②—①—④—③

choices.label: C
choices.text: ③—①—②—④

choices.label: D
choices.text: ④—③—②—①

exercises.explanation: ①先交代学生缺少固定阅读安排的现状，说明问题；②接着提供试行活动后的具体变化，作为事实论据；③分析这一变化说明固定时间和同伴推荐有助于坚持阅读；④最后回扣中心论点，提出推广活动的结论。这样的顺序形成了完整、清晰的论据链。

keypoints.title: 把握情节与人物
keypoints.body: 把握原文情节与人物，是准确梳理故事的起因、发展、转折和结果，理解人物的身份、性格、动机、情感及其变化，并关注人物之间的关系。

keypoints.title: 梳理情节人物
keypoints.body: 阅读时先用时间线或事件链概括关键情节，再标出冲突、转折和未完结线索；结合人物的语言、行动、心理和他人评价概括特点，判断其变化及变化原因，为续写或概要提供依据。

exercises.stem: Read the passage and choose the option that best summarizes the plot and Maya's change. On Saturday morning, Maya borrowed a camera from her neighbor, Mr. Chen, for a school project and promised to return it before noon. At the market, she noticed Leo, a little boy, crying beside the fountain. He had lost his grandmother, who could not hear well. Maya glanced at the clock. If she stayed, she would be late returning the camera. She first led Leo to the information desk, but he shook his head: his grandmother always waited near the flower stalls. Remembering how frightened her own grandmother had once been in a crowded station, Maya decided to help him search. She asked vendors about an elderly woman with a blue umbrella and checked each row with Leo. They finally found the woman near the flower stalls. Maya then hurried to Mr. Chen's house and explained why she was late. Instead of scolding her, he thanked her for returning the camera and for keeping Leo safe. On her way home, Maya realized that being responsible sometimes meant caring for another person's urgent need, not merely keeping a promise to a schedule.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Maya lost Mr. Chen's camera at the market, so she searched for it with Leo and learned to be more careful.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Maya ignored Leo because she wanted to meet her deadline, and Mr. Chen later found Leo's grandmother for him.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Maya faced a choice between returning a borrowed camera on time and helping a lost child; she helped reunite him with his grandmother, explained her delay honestly, and learned that responsibility also involves responding to others' urgent needs.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Maya borrowed the camera to photograph the market, and after Mr. Chen praised her, she decided that deadlines were never important.

exercises.explanation: The story begins with Maya's promise and the conflict between her deadline and Leo's urgent need. The turning point is her decision to help Leo search. After they find his grandmother, Maya honestly explains her lateness to Mr. Chen. Her understanding of responsibility changes from merely being punctual to also caring for someone in urgent need, which is captured only by C.

keypoints.title: 保持原文语言风格
keypoints.body: 与原文的语言风格一致，是在续写或改写时，使词语选择、句式特点、时态语态、叙述视角、语气和正式程度等与原文保持协调，读起来像同一篇文章。

keypoints.title: 先辨风格再仿写
keypoints.body: 先圈出原文中反复出现的关键词、时态、人物称谓和情绪色彩，再模仿其句式长短、叙述语气与衔接方式；表达新内容时不能生硬套用或突然改变文体。

exercises.stem: Read the passage and choose the sentence that best continues it while maintaining the original language style. By the time I reached the pier, the fog had covered the boats. I held the old key in my pocket and listened to the quiet water. My father had told me to wait there until sunset, but the empty pier made me uneasy. Then a bell rang somewhere beyond the fog. I took one step forward.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The fog was super creepy, and I was totally freaking out!

choices.label: B
choices.text: She moves toward the water and looks for the source of the sound.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The fog shifted, and I heard someone call my name.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Consequently, the protagonist proceeded toward the maritime area in accordance with his father's previous instruction.

exercises.explanation: The passage uses first-person narration, the simple past tense, short and clear sentences, concrete images, and a restrained suspenseful tone. C follows the same viewpoint, tense, sentence pattern, and emotional style. A is too colloquial and exaggerated, B changes the tense and viewpoint, and D is excessively formal and uses third-person reference.

keypoints.title: 准确重述原文意思
keypoints.body: 概要写作的同义改写，是在不改变原文核心信息、逻辑关系和语气的前提下，用不同词语、短语或句式准确压缩、重述原意。

keypoints.title: 多种方式灵活改写
keypoints.body: 先提取主干信息，再通过同义词、词性转换、主动与被动互换或合并句子进行改写；改写后核对主语、时态、范围和因果关系，避免逐词替换造成语意偏差。

exercises.stem: Read the paragraph and choose the sentence that most accurately paraphrases its main idea for a summary. When a summer storm cut off the electricity at the community library, twelve-year-old Nia moved the reading club to the hallway of her apartment building. At first, only three children came, but her handwritten notices attracted more neighbors. Within a week, residents had collected enough money to repair the library's generator, and the club returned there.

choices.label: A
choices.text: After a storm caused a power failure at the library, Nia temporarily moved the reading club, and growing support from local residents helped repair the generator so the club could return within a week.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Nia permanently replaced the library with her apartment hallway because the residents did not want to repair the generator.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The library organized a storm fundraiser before Nia moved the reading club to the hallway for three children.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because Nia had repaired the generator, the library's reading club attracted many neighbors before the storm.

exercises.explanation: A preserves the essential information and logical relations: the storm caused the power failure, Nia temporarily relocated the club, residents gradually offered support, the generator was repaired, and the club returned within a week. B changes temporary relocation into a permanent replacement, C changes the sequence and cause, and D reverses the time and responsibility.

keypoints.title: 让情节发展合乎逻辑
keypoints.body: 情节的合理延展，是根据原文已给出的时间、地点、人物性格、矛盾和伏笔，补充合乎因果、符合逻辑且能自然收束的后续事件。

keypoints.title: 按线索推进故事
keypoints.body: 续写前列出已有线索和未解决的问题，按“触发—发展—结果”安排事件；让人物行动有动机，新增情节有铺垫，结局回应前文，避免突然出现无依据的人物、物品或转折。

exercises.stem: Read the passage and choose the most reasonable continuation. On Thursday afternoon, Maya was cleaning the greenhouse behind her school, which would be sold to a developer on Friday. Behind a loose brick, she found a note: “The greenhouse was promised to the students. The proof is where the first bell rang.” Maya knew that the first school bell had hung in the abandoned tower. She also remembered that her grandfather, a former school caretaker, had once said that the tower’s wooden floor had one loose board. She asked Leo to help, and he brought a flashlight and a screwdriver. When they reached the tower, the door was locked, but a small side window was open.

choices.label: A
choices.text: They climbed through the window, lifted the loose floorboard with the screwdriver, and found a sealed copy of the original deed. After the deed was confirmed to require the land to remain for student use, the principal presented it to the school board, which agreed to preserve the greenhouse.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A stranger suddenly appeared beside the tower, gave Maya a golden key, and told her that the greenhouse had been saved by a secret organization.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Although they had the note and the tools, Maya and Leo decided to forget the greenhouse and spend the night searching for treasure in the town park.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Before entering the tower or finding any proof, Maya announced that the greenhouse was safe and invited everyone to celebrate there.

exercises.explanation: A follows all the clues: the open window provides access, the loose board and screwdriver lead to the deed, and the deed connects directly with the note and the conflict about the sale. The school board’s decision gives the story a logical result. B adds an unsupported stranger and object; C abandons the main conflict; D gives a conclusion without evidence.

keypoints.title: 筛选概要核心信息
keypoints.body: 概要写作的信息取舍，是从原文中筛选能体现主题、主要事件及其关键结果的信息，保留必要逻辑，删去例子、细节、重复和不影响主旨的修饰。

keypoints.title: 区分主次合理删减
keypoints.body: 逐段概括后区分主次：主题句、核心观点和关键因果优先保留；人物、时间、地点等只在影响理解时保留。合并同类信息，删去具体描写，并检查删减后文章是否完整连贯。

exercises.stem: Read the original passage and choose the best summary. At Brookdale Public Library, librarians noticed that teenagers rarely came after school. To make the library more useful, Nora, a librarian, invited local residents to give ten-minute talks on practical skills, such as repairing a bicycle or planning a budget. Attendance was small at first. Nora then asked teenagers to suggest topics and helped them advertise the talks online. Within two months, more young people joined, and some even volunteered to lead sessions. The library gradually became a place where residents of different ages learned from one another.

choices.label: A
choices.text: To attract teenagers who seldom visited, a librarian introduced short practical-skill talks and involved them in choosing and promoting topics; participation increased, and the library developed into a community learning place.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Last year, Nora, a librarian at Brookdale, arranged ten-minute talks on bicycle repair and budget planning, which were advertised online and held after school for two months.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Teenagers disliked learning practical skills, so the library had to ask residents to teach them how to repair bicycles and plan budgets.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Libraries should provide interesting activities for people of different ages because this is a good way to improve the community.

exercises.explanation: A retains the main problem, the librarian’s key action, the adjustment that increased participation, and the final result. B includes several details but leaves out the central change and outcome. C changes the meaning, while D gives a general opinion rather than a summary of the passage.

keypoints.title: 两类信件的功能
keypoints.body: 申请信是向学校、机构或组织说明申请事项、资格和意愿，请求获得机会的正式书信；推荐信是由了解申请者的第三方，依据具体表现评价其能力与品格，并提出推荐意见的正式书信。

keypoints.title: 按对象组织内容
keypoints.body: 写申请信可按称呼、申请目的、相关经历或优势、具体请求、致谢与署名展开；写推荐信可按推荐对象与写信人关系、事实依据、突出能力或品质、推荐结论展开。内容应真实具体，语气礼貌诚恳。

exercises.stem: Select TWO appropriate writing choices for the following situation. You are Li Hua, applying for a two-week volunteer position at the City Science Museum. Your English teacher, Mr. Wang, has taught you for two years and has observed that you organized a school science fair and patiently guided younger students. You need to write an application letter and your teacher needs to write a recommendation letter.

choices.label: A
choices.text: In the application letter, state the position you are applying for, explain your interest, mention the relevant experience and strengths, make a specific request, and close with thanks.

choices.label: B
choices.text: In the recommendation letter, introduce Mr. Wang’s relationship with you, use the science fair and guidance experience as evidence, evaluate your organization and patience, and clearly recommend you.

choices.label: C
choices.text: In the application letter, have Mr. Wang write as if he were the applicant and give only general praise without describing your experience.

choices.label: D
choices.text: In the recommendation letter, copy your self-introduction, avoid mentioning the writer’s relationship with you, and make no clear recommendation.

exercises.explanation: An application letter is written by the applicant and should explain the purpose, qualifications, request, and gratitude. A recommendation letter is written by a third party, so it should establish the relationship, provide concrete evidence, evaluate qualities, and state the recommendation. Therefore, A and B are appropriate; C and D confuse the functions and organization of the two letters.

keypoints.title: 投诉与致谢的用途
keypoints.body: 投诉信是针对产品、服务或处理结果不符合预期，向有关个人或机构陈述事实、说明影响并提出合理请求的书信；感谢信是为他人的帮助、支持或善意表达谢意，并说明具体原因和感受的书信。

keypoints.title: 按事实与情感展开
keypoints.body: 投诉信可依次写明时间地点、问题事实、造成的影响和希望的解决办法；感谢信可写感谢对象、具体帮助、带来的影响及祝愿。投诉应就事论事、避免攻击；感谢应具体真诚，避免空泛夸赞。

exercises.stem: 请用英语完成下面两封短笺（每封约60—80词）。你是Li Hua。A. 10月14日，你校向Green Sports店订购的篮球送达，其中两个漏气，校队下周有比赛。请给店长写投诉信，说明事实、影响，并提出在10月20日前更换或退款的请求，语气客观礼貌。B. 10月18日，邻居Ms Brown捡到并归还了你的钱包，且拒绝收取报酬。请写感谢信，说明具体帮助、带来的影响并表达祝愿。
exercises.answer:
A. Dear Manager, On 14 October, our school received the basketballs we ordered from your shop. Unfortunately, two of them were leaking and could not be used. As our team will play next week, this has affected our training. Could you please replace the two basketballs or give us a refund by 20 October? Thank you for your attention. I look forward to your reply. Yours sincerely, Li Hua
B. Dear Ms Brown, Thank you very much for finding and returning my wallet on 18 October. Your honesty saved me from losing my ID card and bank cards, and I was able to continue my trip without trouble. I am especially grateful that you refused a reward. Please accept my sincere thanks. I wish you good health and happiness. Yours sincerely, Li Hua
exercises.explanation: 投诉信应按时间、事实、影响和解决请求展开，并保持客观礼貌，不能进行人身攻击。感谢信应明确感谢对象和具体帮助，说明帮助产生的影响，表达真实谢意和祝愿，避免空泛夸赞。

keypoints.title: 两种书面通信
keypoints.body: 书信是借助邮寄或当面转交等方式传递信息、表达思想的书面通信；电子邮件是通过网络收发的数字化通信，通常包含收件人、主题、正文和发件人信息，必要时还可附加文件。

keypoints.title: 格式与沟通特点
keypoints.body: 书信通常按称呼、正文、结尾和署名组织，适合较完整、较正式或个人化的交流；电子邮件发送迅速，可用主题栏和附件辅助传递信息，正文宜简洁分段。两者都要根据对象、目的选择恰当语气。

exercises.stem: 请用英语写一封70—90词的电子邮件。你是Li Hua，想报名参加由Ms Green负责的校际交换项目。报名截止明天17:00；你将申请表作为附件发送，并希望对方确认是否收到。邮件必须有清晰主题、称呼、简洁分段的正文、礼貌结尾和署名，并提及附件。
exercises.answer:
To: Ms Green
Subject: Application for the Inter-school Exchange Programme
Dear Ms Green,
I would like to apply for the inter-school exchange programme. I have attached my completed application form to this email. As the deadline is 5:00 p.m. tomorrow, could you please confirm that you have received it? Please let me know if any other document is required.
Thank you for your time.
Best regards,
Li Hua
exercises.explanation: 该情境时间紧迫且需要发送附件，电子邮件比纸质书信更合适。答案应有收件人和主题，正文简洁分段，明确报名目的、附件内容和确认请求，并以礼貌结尾和署名收束。

keypoints.title: 通知与公告的区别
keypoints.body: 通知是向特定对象传达活动安排、工作要求或注意事项，并促使其了解或执行的应用文；公告是由组织或机构向较大范围公众正式发布重要事项、决定或消息的应用文。

keypoints.title: 突出事项与行动信息
keypoints.body: 写通知应明确对象、事项、时间、地点、要求、联系人等信息，必要时写明截止时间；写公告应交代发布主体、核心事实和生效或执行时间。标题要醒目，内容准确简洁，避免遗漏关键要素。

exercises.stem: 英语社团要通知本社团成员：6月8日（周六）下午3:00在学校礼堂举行环保主题分享会；参加者须于6月5日前在社团群里报名；联系人为Li Hua。以下哪一项最符合通知与公告的写作要求？

choices.label: A
choices.text: PUBLIC ANNOUNCEMENT\nTo all citizens, an environmental sharing meeting will be held in the school hall on June 8. Everyone is welcome.

choices.label: B
choices.text: NOTICE\nTo all English Club members,\nAn environmental sharing meeting will be held in the school hall at 3:00 p.m. on Saturday, June 8. Please sign up in the club group by June 5. For further information, contact Li Hua.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Dear Li Hua,\nThank you for organizing an environmental sharing meeting. I hope you are well.

choices.label: D
choices.text: NOTICE\nThe English Club will hold an environmental sharing meeting sometime in June. Please attend if possible.

exercises.explanation: 活动安排和执行要求是面向特定对象的通知，B既使用了醒目的NOTICE标题，又明确了对象、事项、时间、地点、报名要求、截止时间和联系人。A把特定对象扩大为公众，且遗漏报名要求和联系人；C是私人书信式表达；D信息不完整。

keypoints.title: 形式与功能
keypoints.body: 海报与倡议书是两种面向公众的应用文。海报用醒目的文字和版式传递活动、通知或宣传信息；倡议书围绕某一事项说明意义、提出行动建议，号召特定对象共同参与。

keypoints.title: 写作要点
keypoints.body: 先明确主题、对象和目的。海报突出标题、关键信息、时间地点及参与方式，语言简洁醒目；倡议书依次写明背景或意义、具体倡议和行动号召，内容具体，语气得体。

exercises.stem: Your school will hold Green Campus Week from May 12 to May 16. Students should bring reusable bottles, refuse disposable cups, and join a clean-up at the school playground at 4:00 p.m. on Friday. Write two English pieces: (1) a poster of 35–45 words, including a clear title, key information and ways to join; (2) an initiative to classmates of 80–100 words, explaining the significance, offering at least two concrete suggestions and ending with a polite call to action.
exercises.answer:
参考答案：Poster: GREEN CAMPUS WEEK
May 12–16 | Our school
Bring a reusable bottle, refuse disposable cups, and keep our campus clean. Join the clean-up at the school playground at 4:00 p.m. on Friday. Bring friends and make every green choice count!

Initiative: Dear classmates, Green Campus Week gives us a chance to protect our shared home and build lasting habits. Let us bring reusable bottles, refuse disposable cups, sort rubbish, and join Friday’s clean-up at the playground at 4:00 p.m. Small actions can reduce waste and make our school more pleasant. Please start today, invite a friend, and remind one another politely. If we work together, Green Campus Week can become a daily habit, not just a one-week event. Let’s keep our campus greener.
exercises.explanation: 海报用醒目的标题开头，突出活动名称、日期、地点、时间和参与方式，语言简洁，便于公众快速获取信息。倡议书先说明环保周的意义，再提出携带水瓶、拒绝一次性杯子、分类垃圾和参加清洁活动等具体建议，最后以礼貌的号召收束，符合面向同学倡议行动的功能。

keypoints.title: 内容与用途
keypoints.body: 报告是围绕工作、调查或活动，依据事实说明情况、结果和建议的应用文；发言稿是为面向听众进行口头表达而写的稿件，用于传达信息、阐明观点或提出主张。报告偏重客观汇报，发言稿更重视听众接受。

keypoints.title: 组织与表达
keypoints.body: 写报告时先交代主题和背景，再分项呈现事实、过程或结果，最后归纳结论并提出建议。写发言稿时可按称呼或问候、主题引入、要点展开、总结号召的顺序组织，句子宜简洁，便于听懂和表达。

exercises.stem: The English Club surveyed 100 students about their daily reading time. The results were: 55 students read for under 20 minutes, 30 for 20–40 minutes, and 15 for over 40 minutes. Sixty-eight students support a daily 20-minute silent-reading period. Write (1) a 60–80-word report to the principal, objectively presenting the background, facts, conclusion and one recommendation; (2) a 50–70-word speech to classmates, using a greeting, a clear message, one reason and a call to action. Use the same facts but adapt the tone to each audience.
exercises.answer:
参考答案：Report on Students’ Reading Time. Last week, the English Club surveyed 100 students about daily reading. Fifty-five read for under 20 minutes, 30 for 20–40 minutes, and 15 for over 40 minutes. Sixty-eight support a daily 20-minute silent-reading period. The results show a need for regular reading. We recommend starting the period on school days and reviewing its effect after one month.

Speech: Good morning, everyone. Our survey shows that 55 of 100 students read for less than 20 minutes a day, while only 15 read for over 40 minutes. Can we give reading more time? A regular period can help us form a habit, and 68 students support it. Let us choose a book and read together every school day. Thank you.
exercises.explanation: 报告按背景、事实、结论和建议组织，使用调查数据，语气客观，适合向校长汇报。发言稿面向同学，先问候，再引入调查结果，用设问增强交流感，说明固定阅读时间有助于养成习惯，最后提出共同阅读的号召，句子简洁、便于口头表达。

keypoints.title: 基本特点
keypoints.body: 演讲稿是演讲者为在特定场合面向听众发表观点、阐明道理或发出号召而准备的口头表达文稿。它以明确主题为核心，兼顾思想性、感染力和现场交流需要。

keypoints.title: 写作步骤
keypoints.body: 先确定听众、场合、目的和中心观点，再用开头引入主题，中间分层论述并结合事例，结尾总结观点、提出号召。多使用短句、呼告、设问和有节奏的表达，增强听讲效果。

exercises.stem: At the final school assembly, you will give a 120–150-word English speech to senior students on reducing food waste in the school cafeteria. Write the speech with a greeting, an engaging question, a clear central view, two supporting points, one concrete example, and a concluding call to action. Use short, natural sentences suitable for oral delivery.
exercises.answer: 参考答案：Good morning, teachers and fellow students. How much food do we throw away in a week? I believe every one of us can help reduce food waste. First, take only what you can finish. Last Friday, I saw half-full plates left after lunch; smaller portions would have prevented that waste. Second, speak up when we order too much and share unopened food according to school rules. Saving food also saves the water, energy, and work behind it. So let us begin with one simple choice: take less, finish it, and encourage a friend to do the same. If we act every day, our cafeteria will become cleaner and our respect for food will grow. Together, we can make every meal count. Thank you.
exercises.explanation: 开头用问候和设问吸引听众，随后明确提出减少食物浪费的中心观点。正文分为两点：按需取餐、避免过量并合理分享，同时用午餐后剩下半盘食物的具体事例支撑观点。结尾总结行动意义并发出号召，短句和呼告适合现场演讲。

keypoints.title: 核心任务
keypoints.body: 审题是准确理解写作任务，明确主题、文体、对象、目的、内容要求和语言限制；构思是在此基础上确定写什么、按什么顺序写以及如何组织材料的过程。二者是动笔前相互衔接的准备。

keypoints.title: 构思流程
keypoints.body: 先圈画题目中的任务、对象、体裁和限制条件，再列出与主题相关的材料，筛选真实、典型且有用的内容；随后确定中心，安排开头、主体和结尾，列出简要提纲后再写作。

exercises.stem: 你准备完成下面的英语写作任务：学校英文校刊拟开设“绿色校园”专栏。请写一篇120—150词的英语短文，面向本校同学，说明校园中的一个环保问题，提出两条可行建议，并说明其中一条建议的好处；语气友好，以一般现在时为主。审题后，下面哪一项构思最恰当？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 文体定为写给市政府的正式建议信，重点介绍全球气候变化，提出一条宏观政策建议，字数不限。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 文体定为面向本校同学的短文；中心是改善校园环保；选取一个真实的校园问题，按“提出问题—给出两条建议并说明其中一条的好处—结尾号召”的顺序组织，控制在120—150词，保持友好语气并以一般现在时为主。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 文体定为第一人称日记，记录自己一天捡垃圾的经历，重点抒发感受，不必提出两条建议。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 先写一篇关于环保的中文长文，再逐句翻译成英语，不必特别考虑读者、词数和时态限制。

exercises.explanation: B完整识别了写作对象、文体、主题、内容要求、篇幅和语言限制，并据此筛选材料、确定中心和安排结构，符合先审题后构思的要求。A改变了对象、文体和内容范围；C遗漏了提出两条建议的任务；D忽略了读者及语言限制。

keypoints.title: 起草与修改的含义
keypoints.body: 起草与修改是写作中先形成初稿、再根据写作目的和读者需要检查并调整内容、结构、语言和格式的连续过程。

keypoints.title: 按步骤完善文章
keypoints.body: 起草时先依据提纲写出完整初稿，不必因个别词句频繁停顿；修改时依次检查主题是否明确、内容是否完整、段落是否连贯、语言是否准确，最后通读并核对格式。

exercises.stem: 你已经为一篇题为“How I Make Better Use of My Weekend”的英语短文列好提纲，读者是同学，字数为100—120词。起草时，你在第一句的一个词上反复停留，后面的内容还没有写。按照“起草与修改”的要求，哪种做法最恰当？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 继续反复打磨第一句，直到用词完全满意后，再开始写后面的内容。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 先依据提纲写出完整初稿，遇到暂时不确定的词句可先标记；初稿完成后，结合写作目的和读者，依次检查主题、内容、段落连贯性、语言准确性，最后通读并核对格式。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 边写边逐句查语法和拼写，任何一句没有改好都不进入下一句，最后不必再检查文章结构。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 先调整字体、标题样式和段落间距，格式完成后再决定文章要写什么内容。

exercises.explanation: 起草阶段的重点是依据提纲先形成完整初稿，不应因个别词句频繁停顿；修改阶段再从主题、内容、结构、语言到格式逐步检查。B体现了这一连续过程。A、C会妨碍初稿完成，D把格式检查置于内容和结构之前。

keypoints.title: 提纲是什么
keypoints.body: 列提纲是在动笔前，用关键词或简短句子梳理中心意思、主要内容、层次和顺序的写作准备活动。

keypoints.title: 列提纲的方法
keypoints.body: 先明确写作目的、对象和中心意思；再列出开头、主体、结尾及各段要点，按逻辑排序，并补充必要细节。提纲应简明，能够指导成文。

exercises.stem: 英文社团要编写“Healthy School Life”专栏。请写一篇100—120词的英语短文，面向同学，介绍一个你坚持的健康习惯，说明开始或坚持的方法和带来的变化，最后鼓励同学尝试。以下哪一项最适合作为动笔前的提纲？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 直接写成完整文章：介绍习惯、说明原因、描述变化、发出号召；写作时再临时决定各部分的先后。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 开头：健康习惯——每天晚饭后快走；主体一：开始原因——久坐、精力不足；主体二：坚持方法——从10分钟开始、邀请朋友、每周记录；主体三：带来的变化——睡眠和精力改善；结尾：鼓励同学从小目标开始。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 开头：号召同学健康生活；主体：睡眠、饮食、运动和心理健康；结尾：再次号召同学行动。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 开头：健康生活；主体：习惯、坚持、变化；结尾：鼓励同学。

exercises.explanation: B用关键词和简短短语明确了中心习惯、主要内容、必要细节及开头—主体—结尾的逻辑顺序，能够直接指导成文。A没有真正列出提纲，C同时铺开多个主题，D内容过于笼统，难以指导写作。

keypoints.title: 句式多样与高级表达
keypoints.body: 句式多样性与高级表达，是根据语意和语境灵活使用长短句、并列句、复合句等不同结构，准确、连贯且有层次地表达，而不是单纯堆砌复杂句式。

keypoints.title: 复杂不等于表达高级
keypoints.body: 句式变化应服务于信息重点和逻辑关系。长短句结合可形成节奏，恰当的复合结构可表达因果、转折、条件等关系；若复杂结构导致语法错误或理解困难，就不是有效的高级表达。

exercises.stem: 下列四种对同一组信息的英语表达中，最符合“句式有变化、逻辑清楚且不过度追求复杂”的要求的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: Reading widely broadens our horizons, and because it helps us understand people from different backgrounds, therefore students should make it a regular habit.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Reading widely broadens our horizons. More importantly, it helps us understand people from different backgrounds; for this reason, students should make it a regular habit.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Reading widely, which broadens our horizons and helps us understand people from different backgrounds, therefore students should make it a regular habit.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Reading widely is a habit that broadens our horizons and helps us understand people from different backgrounds and is why, therefore, students should make it regular.

exercises.explanation: B用短句先突出“开阔视野”，再用含有递进和因果关系的句子补充信息，长短结合，层次清楚。A同时使用because和therefore，结构重复；C和D的句子结构不完整或过于拖沓，影响理解。

keypoints.title: 规范书写的含义
keypoints.body: 拼写、标点与格式规范，是按照英语书面表达习惯书写单词、使用大小写和标点，并合理安排词间空格、段落、标题等版式，使文本准确、清楚、易读。

keypoints.title: 定稿前逐项检查
keypoints.body: 定稿前检查单词拼写和大小写、句末标点与逗号等符号、词间空格、分段及标题格式，并特别核对专名、缩写等写法是否前后一致。

exercises.stem: 下列是同一则英语通知的四种定稿版本。哪一项在拼写、大小写、标点、词间空格、分段和格式方面最规范？

choices.label: A
choices.text:
A Visit to the Museum

Dear Classmates,

We will visit the museum on Saturday, May 18. Please meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m. Bring your student ID and a notebook.

Best regards,
Li Hua

choices.label: B
choices.text:
a visit to the Museum

Dear classmates

We will visit the museum on saturday, May 18. Please meet at the school gate at 8:00a.m.Bring your student ID and a notebook.

Best regards
Li hua

choices.label: C
choices.text:
A Visit to the Museum

Dear Classmates,

We will visit the museum on Saturday, May 18. Please meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m, Bring your student ID and a notebook.

Best regards,
Li Hua

choices.label: D
choices.text:
A Visit to the Museum

Dear Classmates,

We will visit the museum on Saturday,May 18. Please meet at the school gate at 8:00 a.m. Bring your student ID and a notebook.

Best regards, Li Hua

exercises.explanation: A的标题采用恰当的大小写，Saturday和May等专名首字母大写；逗号、句号和a.m.的写法规范，词间空格正确，正文和结尾分段清晰。B、C、D分别存在大小写、标点、空格或书信格式问题。

keypoints.title: 形成知识联系网络
keypoints.body: 建构语言知识网络，是将词汇、语法、语音、语篇等知识按意义、形式和使用条件建立联系，形成便于理解、记忆、检索和扩展的结构化知识系统。

keypoints.title: 分类联结并持续更新
keypoints.body: 以主题或语篇为线索，记录核心词、搭配、词形变化、句型和使用场景，通过分类、对比、联想或图示建立联系；再用例句和语言任务检索所学，并根据新发现及时补充、修正。

exercises.stem: 学习完一篇关于减少塑料污染的语篇后，学生要围绕核心词 reduce 建立语言知识网络。下列哪份学习记录最符合“按意义、形式和使用条件建立联系，并通过任务检索、持续更新”的要求？

choices.label: A
choices.text: reduce—减少；抄写20遍。

choices.label: B
choices.text: reduce：意为“使变少”；相关词有 reuse 和 recycle；词形可联系 reduction；搭配有 reduce waste、reduce CO2、reduce sth. by 20%；例句为“We can reduce plastic waste by using reusable bags.”；在后续阅读中继续补充相关表达和使用场景。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 把本单元所有单词按字母顺序排列，只记录中文意思。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 只记住 reduce price 这一搭配，并在所有语境中都使用这一搭配。

exercises.explanation: B同时联系了词义、语义相关词、词形、搭配、句型、例句和语境，并提出根据后续阅读补充网络，体现了结构化、可检索且持续更新的学习方式。A只重复记忆，C缺少联系，D把一个搭配机械套用于所有语境。

keypoints.title: 从例子发现规则
keypoints.body: 归纳是从多个语言实例中比较异同、提炼共同特征，概括一般规律；演绎是依据已知规律分析具体实例、判断语言形式或生成新的表达。二者相互配合，帮助理解和运用语言。

keypoints.title: 先归纳后验证运用
keypoints.body: 先收集并标记语言实例，比较其形式、意义和使用条件，提出规律；再用新例子检验，关注特殊情况，必要时修正规则，最后运用规律分析或生成新的语言表达。

exercises.stem: 一名学生想归纳英语被动语态的使用规律。他收集了以下例句：The window was broken during the storm. The homework is checked every Friday. The results have been announced. 下列哪种学习过程最符合“先归纳后验证运用”的方法？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 先背诵语法书中的定义，再把定义逐字抄写到每个例句旁。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 比较例句中be动词和过去分词的形式、时态及主语与动作的关系，提出规律；再用新句子检验，并留意不规则过去分词等特殊情况。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 只根据第一个例句判断所有被动句的be动词都用was，不再比较其他例句。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 把每个例句翻译成汉语，只要译文通顺，就认为已经掌握了被动语态规律。

exercises.explanation: B先从多个例句中比较形式、意义和使用条件，归纳出一般规律；再用新例子检验并关注特殊情况，这体现了从实例到规律的归纳，以及依据规律分析新实例的演绎。A偏重机械记忆，C以单个例句概括且结论错误，D没有形成语言规律。

keypoints.title: 记录并分析学习信息
keypoints.body: 记笔记与整理错题，是有选择地记录重要知识、解题思路、疑问和错误信息，并按内容分类、追溯错误原因、保留正确方法，形成便于复习和迁移的学习资料。

keypoints.title: 按要素整理和复盘
keypoints.body: 笔记突出关键词、结构和例句，避免整段抄写；错题记录题目要点、错误答案、错误原因、正确方法和相似例题。复习时遮盖答案重做，归纳同类问题并检查是否真正改正。

exercises.stem: 某同学在练习中写道：If I knew the news yesterday, I would have called you. 参考答案为：If I had known the news yesterday, I would have called you. 下列哪一项最适合作为他的错题整理记录？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 只写下正确答案had known，复习时反复朗读这一短语。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 分类为“虚拟条件句”；记录自己误用knew、混淆了过去情况的虚拟结构；归纳“if从句用had＋过去分词，主句常用would have＋过去分词”的方法，并补充相似例句，之后遮住答案重做。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 把整页关于条件句的教材内容全部抄下来，不记录本题的错误原因。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 在题目旁写“粗心”，然后删去原答案，避免以后再看到错误。

exercises.explanation: B记录了题目所属类型、错误答案、具体错因、正确方法和相似例句，并安排遮盖答案重做，便于复习和迁移。A只有结论，C抄写过多但缺少针对性，D没有分析错误原因，均不利于真正改正。

keypoints.title: 结合线索理解信息
keypoints.body: 借助语境与背景知识加工信息，是依据语篇前后关系、交际场合、主题以及已有的文化和生活经验，对词句和信息进行理解、推断、筛选与整合。

keypoints.title: 预测推断再核验
keypoints.body: 阅读或听前根据标题、图片和主题预测内容；过程中利用上下文、语气和逻辑关系推断词句含义，结合已有知识整合信息；完成后回看全文，核对推断并区分明示信息与合理推断。

exercises.stem: 阅读短文：Leo's commute takes nearly an hour. Every morning, he leaves home at 7:00, takes the subway, and arrives at the office before 8:00. In the evening, he makes the same trip in reverse. 第一次遇到commute时，哪种处理方式最恰当？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 只看commute这个词本身，凭词形猜测其含义，不利用上下文。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 结合每天、离家、乘地铁、到办公室以及晚上返回等线索，并联系生活经验，推断commute指往返家和工作地点的日常行程，再回看全文核验。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 因为commute出现在office附近，就断定它只表示“办公室”。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 遇到生词就跳过，认为上下文和已有知识不能帮助理解词义。

exercises.explanation: 上下文中的时间频率、出发地点、交通方式、办公室和往返路线共同表明commute是日常上下班行程；已有生活经验可帮助形成合理推断，回看全文则能核验推断。B同时利用了语境、背景知识和核验步骤。

keypoints.title: 用熟悉的话转述
keypoints.body: 迂回表达与释义是在不会、想不起或不便直接使用某个词语时，用更熟悉的词语、定义、特征、用途、例子或近义说法说明原意，使对方能够理解。

keypoints.title: 分解信息再说明
keypoints.body: 先抓住要表达对象的类别和核心特征，再用简单词语说明它是什么、做什么或有什么特点；必要时补充例子，并根据对方反应改换说法。

exercises.stem: 在英语交流中，你想借一个“保温杯”，但一时想不起单词 thermos。你希望对方能理解你说的物品。下列哪种说法最符合“迂回表达与释义”？

choices.label: A
choices.text: It's a thing. I need it.

choices.label: B
choices.text: It's a container that you can put hot drinks in. It keeps them hot for a long time.

choices.label: C
choices.text: You know it. Give me that.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is very important and useful.

exercises.explanation: B先说明物品的类别（container），再说明用途和核心特征（装热饮并保持较长时间温度），即使不说出 thermos，也能帮助对方理解原意，符合迂回表达与释义的策略。

keypoints.title: 借助动作和表情沟通
keypoints.body: 借助非语言手段沟通，是运用手势、表情、眼神、身体姿态、图片、实物或语音语调等传递、补充或强化语言信息。

keypoints.title: 语言不足时辅助表达
keypoints.body: 遇到词语不会、环境嘈杂或对方未听清时，可指向实物、做动作、画图或用表情示意，同时配合简短语言；要观察对方反应，及时调整表达。

exercises.stem: 教室里很吵，Lily没有听清你想借剪刀。下列哪种做法最符合“借助非语言手段沟通”，并能帮助她理解你的意思？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Repeat the same sentence while turning away from her.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Point to the scissors, make a cutting gesture, and say, “Could you pass me the scissors, please?” Then watch her reaction.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Say nothing and wait for her to guess what you want.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Use a long and difficult sentence without any gesture.

exercises.explanation: B同时使用指向实物和剪切动作等非语言手段，并配合简短语言；随后观察对方反应，能够在嘈杂环境中补充和强化语言信息，符合借助非语言手段沟通的要求。

keypoints.title: 主动消除理解偏差
keypoints.body: 请求澄清与确认是在信息不清楚、不完整或可能误解时，请对方重复、解释或换一种说法，并复述关键信息，请对方确认自己是否理解正确。

keypoints.title: 先问清再复述确认
keypoints.body: 先指出不明之处，提出具体请求，如请对方重复、放慢语速或解释关键词；听后用自己的话复述重点，再询问是否准确，避免凭猜测继续交流。

exercises.stem: 同学对你说：“Please send me the revised plan by Friday afternoon.” 你不确定他说的是本周五，还是下周五，也不确定应通过什么方式发送。下列哪种回复最符合“请求澄清与确认”？

choices.label: A
choices.text: Okay, I'll do it.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Could you say that again?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Sorry, could you clarify whether you mean this Friday afternoon and whether I should email it? So, to confirm, I need to email the revised plan to you by this Friday afternoon, right?

choices.label: D
choices.text: I think I understand, so there is no need to explain.

exercises.explanation: C先具体指出不清楚的地方，并询问日期和发送方式；然后用自己的话复述关键信息，最后请求对方确认，能够避免因猜测造成理解偏差。B只请求重复，没有进一步复述确认。

keypoints.title: 明确方向并安排行动
keypoints.body: 制订学习目标与计划，是依据学习需要和实际水平，确定具体、可达成的学习结果，并安排学习内容、时间、方法、资源和检查调整方式。

keypoints.title: 目标分层定期调整
keypoints.body: 先确定阶段目标，再分解为可观察的短期任务，按重要性安排时间和练习；设置完成标准与检查日期，记录进展，根据效果及时调整计划。

exercises.stem: 高二学生小林希望在8周后提高英语说明文阅读能力，能在25分钟内完成一篇约350词的文章，正确率达到80%。以下哪项计划最符合“目标分层定期调整”的要求？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 每天有空就读英语文章，读到哪里算哪里，不规定完成标准。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 先把所有阅读词汇背完，再开始做阅读练习，期间不安排检查。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 把8周目标分解为每周精读2篇文章、完成1次限时练习；每周日记录用时和正确率，找出错题原因，并根据结果调整下周的文章难度和练习时间。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 每天只做自己最擅长的题型，保持学习兴趣，等8周结束后再判断效果。

exercises.explanation: C将阶段目标分解为可观察的短期任务，安排了练习内容和时间，并设置了每周检查、记录和调整方式，符合制订学习目标与计划的要求。A、D缺少明确标准和检查，B的安排缺乏阶段性和反馈。

keypoints.title: 监控并及时修正
keypoints.body: 监控与调整学习过程，是学习者依据目标持续关注自己的学习计划、方法、进度和效果，发现偏差或困难后分析原因，并及时改变策略、安排或行动的过程。

keypoints.title: 检查、诊断、调整
keypoints.body: 学习前明确目标和标准；学习中用清单、记录或练习结果检查进度与效果；发现偏差后分析原因，调整任务难度、学习方法、顺序或时间，再检验调整是否有效。

exercises.stem: 小周计划用4周提高英语听力，标准是每周完成4段听力并在练习中达到80%的正确率。第一周他只完成2段，平均正确率为55%；学习记录显示，他只是反复播放录音，很少分析错因。此时最恰当的监控与调整做法是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 维持原计划不变，多听一些材料，认为练习量增加后自然会提高。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 立即把目标降为40%，以后只练习容易听懂的材料。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 根据记录诊断出练习不足且方法单一，改为先听主旨、再记录关键词并结合听力原文定位错误；三天后用一段新材料复测，再根据结果调整。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 暂时停止听力训练，改为背诵语法规则，因为听力错误难以避免。

exercises.explanation: C先依据完成量、正确率和学习记录检查偏差，再分析原因，随后调整方法并安排复测，形成“检查—诊断—调整—再检验”的过程。A没有修正，B回避目标，D没有针对听力问题进行有效诊断。

keypoints.title: 评价学习并总结改进
keypoints.body: 自我评价与反思，是学习者依据目标、标准和学习证据，判断自己的表现与进步，分析有效做法和存在问题，并提出后续改进方向的过程。

keypoints.title: 依据证据反思
keypoints.body: 完成任务后，对照评价标准查看作品、练习结果或学习记录，回答“哪些地方做得好、问题在哪里、原因是什么、下次怎么改”，把结论转化为具体可执行的改进措施。

exercises.stem: 小陈完成一篇英语议论文后，依据评分标准和草稿进行检查：内容得分4/5，篇章组织得分2/5，语言得分3/5；学习记录显示，他写作前没有列提纲，段落主题句也不清楚。以下哪项反思最恰当？

choices.label: A
choices.text: 我的英语写作能力很差，今后只要背更多范文和万能句型就可以了。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 内容得分较高，说明文章总体没有问题，篇章组织暂时不用改进。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 评分和草稿表明内容是优势，但组织较弱，可能与写前未列提纲、主题句不清有关；下次先用5分钟列提纲，明确中心论点和段落主题句，写完后按评分标准检查，并比较下一次的组织得分。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 让同学直接帮我修改文章，之后照着修改稿抄写一遍即可。

exercises.explanation: C使用评分结果、草稿和学习记录等证据评价表现，指出优势和问题，分析问题原因，并提出可执行、可检验的改进措施，体现了自我评价与反思。其他选项要么笼统否定自己，要么忽视问题或缺少自主改进。

keypoints.title: 合理配置时间精力
keypoints.body: 时间与精力管理，是根据学习目标、任务轻重缓急、难度和自身状态，合理安排学习时段、任务顺序、专注强度与休息，以提高学习效率并保持持续学习能力。

keypoints.title: 规划任务与节奏
keypoints.body: 先按重要性和截止时间确定优先任务，再把大任务分成小步骤并安排时段；专注学习与适当休息交替进行，根据当天的精力状态调整任务难度和学习节奏。

exercises.stem: 周日，李明有三项英语学习任务：周一早上要提交演讲提纲（重要且紧急，约需1小时），周五要完成一份较难的英语阅读报告（约需2小时），还要复习当天的词汇（约30分钟）。他下午精力较低，晚上20:00—21:30精力最好。下列安排最符合时间与精力管理原则的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 下午一开始连续完成2小时阅读报告，之后再看时间决定是否写演讲提纲。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 先确定演讲提纲为最高优先任务，安排在晚上高精力时段完成；下午低精力时先复习词汇，并把阅读报告拆成资料整理、列提纲等小步骤分时完成，学习间适当休息。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 先把最容易的词汇复习多做几遍，等所有轻松任务完成后再考虑演讲提纲。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 把三项任务平均分配到下午和晚上，尽量连续学习，不安排休息，以保证计划不被打乱。

exercises.explanation: 演讲提纲截止时间最近且重要，应优先安排；阅读报告可拆分为小步骤并分时完成。下午精力较低时安排相对适宜的任务，晚上精力充沛时处理需要较高专注的任务，同时穿插休息并根据状态调整，体现了合理配置时间、任务顺序、专注强度和节奏。

keypoints.title: 在真实情境中学习
keypoints.body: 利用真实语言环境学习，是在日常生活或接近真实交际的情境中接触、理解和使用英语，通过语境、对象和交际目的体会语言意义与用法，并逐步形成实际运用能力。

keypoints.title: 接触、理解、使用
keypoints.body: 选择与生活或兴趣相关的真实英语材料和交际场景，先结合语境理解信息，再记录有用表达并模仿、复述或交流；遇到不懂之处结合上下文和可靠资源核实，在新的情境中再次使用。

exercises.stem: 王芳想提高自己在机场用英语交流的能力。下列学习方案最符合“利用真实语言环境学习”的要求的是：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 背诵一份机场英语词汇表和中文译文，不必接触具体语境。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 使用真实航空公司网站、机场提示语或登机对话材料，先结合场景理解信息，再查证不懂之处，摘录有用表达并进行模仿、复述，最后与同伴进行值机和问路的英语情境交流。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 只听英语材料，不记录表达，也不尝试开口使用，以免形成错误。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 把所有材料逐句翻译成中文，重点记住中文意思，不考虑说话对象和交际目的。

exercises.explanation: 真实语言环境学习强调在接近实际交际的材料或场景中，结合语境理解语言，再记录、模仿、复述并在新的情境中使用。B完整体现了接触、理解、核实和使用的过程；其他选项要么脱离语境，要么缺少实际运用。

keypoints.title: 认识词典与语法工具书
keypoints.body: 词典和语法工具书是查考语言知识的工具，可帮助学习者确认词义、读音、词性、搭配、例句及语法规则，提升理解和表达的准确性。

keypoints.title: 按需查找并验证
keypoints.body: 先明确要查的内容，再选择合适的工具书；查词时关注词性、义项、搭配和例句，查语法时结合规则与示例，最后联系上下文判断是否适用，并记录有用信息。

keypoints.title: 避免机械套用释义
keypoints.body: 不要只选择词典中的第一个义项，也不要脱离语境套用例句或语法规则。遇到多义词、特殊用法和不确定情况，应比较不同释义并进一步核对。

exercises.stem: 在阅读句子“The museum is accessible to visitors with disabilities.”时，张华不确定 accessible 在此处的含义和用法。下列做法中，恰当的有：

choices.label: A
choices.text: 先明确自己需要查的是该词在句中的词性、具体义项及相关搭配。

choices.label: B
choices.text: 查词典时比较不同义项，关注词性、例句和“accessible to”这一搭配，再根据句中的 museum 和 visitors with disabilities 判断最合适的含义。

choices.label: C
choices.text: 直接采用词典列出的第一个中文释义，不再结合原句判断。

choices.label: D
choices.text: 如果仍不确定该搭配或句法特点，可用可靠的语法或搭配工具核对规则和示例，并尝试在新语境中造句验证。

exercises.explanation: 查工具书应先明确问题，再结合词性、义项、搭配、例句和上下文进行选择；必要时还要用可靠的语法或搭配资料核实，并通过新的语境验证。C机械采用第一个释义，忽略了多义词和语境，不符合正确的查证方法。

keypoints.title: 理解数字资源与语料库
keypoints.body: 数字资源包括电子词典、学习网站、数据库和多媒体材料等；语料库是按一定方式收集、整理并可检索的真实语言材料，用于观察词语和句式的实际使用情况。

keypoints.title: 检索并比较真实用例
keypoints.body: 根据学习目标选择可靠资源，用关键词检索，再观察语料中的上下文、词性、搭配和使用频率；比较多个例句和来源，归纳较自然、较常见的表达。

keypoints.title: 不盲信搜索结果
keypoints.body: 网络上出现的表达不一定规范或适合当前语境，语料出现频率高也不等于任何场合都能使用。应核对来源、语境和权威工具，避免直接照搬。

exercises.stem: A senior high school student wants to decide whether “make a great progress” is acceptable in a formal English essay. Which is the most reliable way to investigate the expression?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Search a reputable learner’s dictionary and a trustworthy corpus, check the word’s grammar and countability, compare several examples in formal contexts, and then choose the form supported by the evidence.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use it because many ordinary web pages contain the expression.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Copy the first sentence shown by a search engine without checking its source or context.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Accept the translation provided by one online tool because digital tools are always correct.

exercises.explanation: A combines reliable digital resources with corpus evidence. The learner should examine grammar, context, and multiple examples rather than judge an expression only by its online frequency. Search results and translation tools may contain errors or unsuitable language, so B, C, and D are unreliable.

keypoints.title: 认识灾害与防灾减灾
keypoints.body: 自然灾害是由地震、洪水、台风、干旱等自然现象引发的人员伤亡、财产损失或生态破坏。防灾减灾包括风险识别、监测预警、日常准备、应急避险和灾后恢复。

keypoints.title: 防灾贯穿灾害全过程
keypoints.body: 不同灾害的成因、影响范围和危险表现不同，防范措施也应有所区别。有效防灾需要在灾前减少风险、灾中正确避险和救援、灾后及时恢复并总结改进。

keypoints.title: 分阶段分析防灾措施
keypoints.body: 分析一种灾害时，可依次说明其类型和成因、可能危害、预警信号及应对措施，再分别列出灾前准备、灾中避险和灾后救助要点。

exercises.stem: A typhoon is expected to reach a coastal city tomorrow. Write three brief pieces of advice in English, one for each stage: before the typhoon, during the typhoon, and after the typhoon. Include a preparation, a safety action, and a recovery or reporting action.
exercises.answer: Before the typhoon, follow official warnings, secure loose objects, and prepare water, food, a flashlight, and necessary medicine. During the typhoon, stay indoors away from windows and do not use flooded roads. After the typhoon, leave only when authorities say it is safe, avoid fallen wires and floodwater, and report damage to the authorities.
exercises.explanation: The answer analyzes disaster prevention by stages. Before the disaster, it reduces risk through preparation and attention to warnings; during the disaster, it emphasizes safe shelter and avoiding dangerous areas; after the disaster, it focuses on safe recovery and reporting. Other expressions are acceptable if they convey the same ideas accurately.

keypoints.title: 理解生态与生物多样性
keypoints.body: 自然生态是生物与其周围非生物环境相互作用形成的系统。生物多样性包括遗传多样性、物种多样性和生态系统多样性，体现生命形式及其生态系统的丰富程度。

keypoints.title: 生态系统相互依存
keypoints.body: 生态系统中生物通过食物关系等形成联系，物质循环和能量流动维持系统运行。生物多样性为生态系统提供多种功能，也有助于增强其抵御和恢复环境变化的能力。

keypoints.title: 生态与多样性相互影响
keypoints.body: 生态系统为物种生存提供栖息地和资源，生物多样性又参与维持生态系统功能。栖息地破坏、污染和过度利用可能同时导致生态失衡与生物多样性下降。

exercises.stem: A wetland is drained and polluted, and one of its fish species is heavily caught. Which conclusions are supported by the relationship between ecosystems and biodiversity? Select all that apply.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The destruction of the wetland habitat may reduce the survival of several species.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A decline in the fish population may affect food relationships and ecosystem functions.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The loss of biodiversity may make the ecosystem less able to resist or recover from environmental changes.

choices.label: D
choices.text: As long as some plants remain, pollution and habitat loss will not affect the ecosystem’s functions.

exercises.explanation: A is correct because habitats provide organisms with space and resources. B is correct because species are connected through food relationships, so a change in one population may influence the wider ecosystem. C is correct because biodiversity can strengthen an ecosystem’s resistance and recovery. D is incorrect: remaining plants cannot guarantee that pollution and habitat destruction have no effects.

keypoints.title: 概念与目标
keypoints.body: 环境问题是自然变化或人类活动导致的环境质量下降、生态失衡及其影响；环境保护则是通过预防、治理和修复，减少这种影响，维护人与自然的协调。

keypoints.title: 主要特点
keypoints.body: 环境问题往往具有复杂性、长期性和跨区域性，治理不能只处理污染结果，还要减少源头排放、合理利用资源并保护生态系统。

exercises.stem: A coastal city finds that factory emissions and untreated wastewater have reduced air and river quality. Instead of cleaning the river only after pollution occurs, it requires factories to cut emissions at the source, improves waste treatment, restores wetlands, and works with neighboring cities. Which statement best describes this approach?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Environmental protection means using technology to remove all natural changes.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Environmental problems are short-term local events, so each city can act alone.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Environmental protection aims to reduce environmental impacts through prevention, treatment, and restoration, because environmental problems can be complex, long-lasting, and cross-regional.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Economic development should stop completely whenever an environmental problem appears.

exercises.explanation: The approach includes reducing pollution at its source, treating existing pollution, restoring ecosystems, and cooperating across regions. These actions reflect the goal of environmental protection and respond to the complexity, long-term nature, and cross-regional effects of environmental problems.

keypoints.title: 核心含义
keypoints.body: 资源与可持续发展强调在资源承载能力和生态环境限度内满足当代需求，同时不损害后代满足需求的能力，兼顾资源利用、环境保护和社会发展。

keypoints.title: 实践方法
keypoints.body: 使用资源时应优先节约和高效利用，减少浪费与污染，推广可再生资源和循环利用，并根据资源承载能力安排生产生活。

exercises.stem: A dry region plans to build a new industrial park. Which plan best follows the idea and methods of sustainable development?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Set water-use limits according to the region’s capacity, require water-saving equipment, reuse treated water, and protect the needs of both present residents and future generations.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Use as much groundwater as possible to achieve rapid economic growth, even if the water table continues to fall.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Meet present demand by using more fossil fuels and sending untreated industrial waste into a nearby river.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ban all production and consumption so that no natural resource will ever be used.

exercises.explanation: Sustainable development meets current needs without reducing future generations’ ability to meet theirs. Option A respects resource capacity, saves and reuses resources, reduces environmental pressure, and considers both present and future social needs.

keypoints.title: 概念界定
keypoints.body: 宇宙探索是人类借助观测、探测和实验认识宇宙的活动；航天是利用运载工具和航天器在地球大气层外飞行、工作及返回的技术与活动。

keypoints.title: 二者的关系
keypoints.body: 宇宙探索提出科学目标和任务，航天技术提供进入、运行和返回空间的手段；二者相互促进，探索需求推动航天技术发展，技术进步又拓展探索范围。

exercises.stem: Scientists want to study whether Mars once had conditions suitable for life. They set the scientific goals, while engineers design a launch vehicle, an orbiter, a landing system, and a return capsule. What does this example best show?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Space exploration and aerospace are unrelated because one is science and the other is technology.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Space exploration provides scientific goals, while aerospace provides the means to enter, operate in, and return from space; each promotes the development of the other.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Aerospace refers only to observing Earth from the ground.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Scientific exploration can be completed without observation, experiments, or spacecraft.

exercises.explanation: The scientific question comes from space exploration, and aerospace technology makes launch, operation near Mars, landing, and return possible. New exploration needs drive technological progress, while improved technology allows people to explore farther and in greater depth.

keypoints.title: 概念辨析
keypoints.body: 天气是某地大气在短时间内的状态及变化；气候是某地多年天气状况的统计特征和变化规律；季节是因年内周期性变化而形成的时间段。

keypoints.title: 避免混淆
keypoints.body: 不能把一次降温称为气候变化，也不能用某一天的天气概括全年气候；季节划分还会因纬度、海陆位置和划分标准不同而有差异。

exercises.stem: Read the four statements. Which one correctly distinguishes weather, climate and seasons?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A typhoon affecting a city this week is weather, while the city's long-term rainfall pattern is part of its climate.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A cold spell lasting three days proves that the region's climate has changed.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Climate means the condition of the atmosphere at a particular moment.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because seasons repeat every year, their dates and length are identical everywhere.

exercises.explanation: Weather describes the atmospheric condition and changes over a short period, such as a typhoon this week. Climate refers to the statistical features and patterns of weather over many years. A short cold spell cannot prove climate change, and seasons may differ in timing and length because of latitude, location and division standards.

keypoints.title: 概念界定
keypoints.body: 日常活动与作息是指人在一天中进行的起床、上学、学习、休息、用餐等经常性活动，以及这些活动的时间安排和先后顺序。

keypoints.title: 按时间顺序表达
keypoints.body: 介绍日常活动时，可按“早晨—白天—晚上”的顺序组织内容，说明活动、时间和频率，并使用表示先后、时刻和频率的词语，使作息安排清晰完整。

exercises.stem: Write 5–6 English sentences about your weekday routine. Organize your description in the order of morning, daytime and evening. Include at least four daily activities, the times of at least three activities, one frequency expression such as usually or often, and at least two sequence expressions such as first, then, after that or finally.
exercises.answer: First, I usually get up at 6:30 a.m. and have breakfast at 7:00. Then I go to school at 7:30 and attend classes in the morning. At noon, I have lunch and often take a short rest. After school, I do my homework from 4:30 to 6:00 p.m. In the evening, I usually read for half an hour and go to bed at 10:30. Finally, I prepare my schoolbag for the next day.
exercises.explanation: The sample organizes activities from morning to evening and clearly includes activities, specific times, frequency words such as usually and often, and sequence expressions such as first, then, after school and finally. Other grammatically correct routines are also acceptable if they meet the stated requirements.

keypoints.title: 概念界定
keypoints.body: 饮食健康与运动是指通过合理选择食物、保持适当饮食习惯和进行规律、适量的身体活动来维护身体健康的生活方式。

keypoints.title: 制定健康计划
keypoints.body: 讨论健康生活时，可分别说明饮食内容、运动项目、运动频率及其益处，再用建议或计划的方式表达如何保持均衡饮食和适量运动。

exercises.stem: Your classmate wants to live more healthily but eats too much fast food and rarely exercises. Write an English health plan of 80–100 words for the classmate. Include healthy food choices, an exercise activity, its frequency, at least two benefits, and two suggestions using expressions such as should, can or try to.
exercises.answer: Here is my plan for a healthier week. I will eat oatmeal, eggs, fruit and milk for breakfast, and add vegetables, beans, fish or lean meat to my lunch and dinner. I will drink water instead of sugary drinks and limit fast food. I will walk or cycle for 30 minutes five days a week and play basketball at the weekend. This plan can give me steady energy, improve my fitness and help me sleep better. I should eat regularly, and I can keep a simple record to follow the plan.
exercises.explanation: A complete answer should propose balanced food choices and suitable eating habits, name an appropriate exercise, state how often it will be done, explain at least two benefits, and use advice or plan expressions. The sample covers all these points and presents regular, moderate exercise rather than excessive activity.

keypoints.title: 概念界定
keypoints.body: 个人情感与人际关系包括个人对自己或他人的喜爱、快乐、担忧、失望等情绪，以及与家人、朋友、同学等建立、维持和改善关系的过程。

keypoints.title: 恰当表达与沟通
keypoints.body: 交流情感和关系时，应先说明感受或态度，再表达原因和需要；面对分歧要认真倾听、礼貌回应，避免使用伤害他人的言语。

exercises.stem: Your classmate has recently ignored your messages because of a misunderstanding. You feel worried and disappointed, but want to improve your relationship. Which reply is the most appropriate?

choices.label: A
choices.text: You are so selfish. Don't talk to me again.

choices.label: B
choices.text: I feel worried and disappointed because we haven't talked about what happened. Could you tell me how you feel? I'd like us to discuss it calmly.

choices.label: C
choices.text: If you don't explain yourself now, I will tell everyone what you did.

choices.label: D
choices.text: It's all your fault, but I suppose we can forget it.

exercises.explanation: B先表达自己的感受，再说明原因和需要，并邀请对方表达感受、进行平静沟通，符合礼貌回应和改善关系的要求。A、C、D含有指责、威胁或伤害性语言。

keypoints.title: 概念界定
keypoints.body: 兴趣爱好与文娱活动是指个人因喜欢或享受而选择的休闲活动，如阅读、音乐、绘画、观影、游戏及参与演出等。

keypoints.title: 介绍兴趣活动
keypoints.body: 介绍兴趣爱好时，可说明喜欢的活动、参与频率、进行方式和喜爱原因；谈论共同兴趣时，还可以提出邀请并对他人的选择作出回应。

exercises.stem: You are introducing your hobby to a new friend. Which response best follows an appropriate way of talking about an interest?

choices.label: A
choices.text: I like movies.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Movies are popular, and my cousin likes them too.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I enjoy making short videos. I do it about twice a month with my phone because it helps me tell stories. Are you interested in making one together? If you'd rather do something else, that's fine.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I make videos, so you should join my club.

exercises.explanation: C说明了喜欢的活动、参与频率、进行方式和喜爱原因，还提出了邀请并尊重对方的选择，信息完整、表达得体。A和B信息不完整，D语气强硬，没有回应对方选择的空间。

keypoints.title: 理财与理性消费的含义
keypoints.body: 理财是对收入、支出、储蓄等进行合理安排；理性消费是在满足实际需要和自身承受能力的基础上，比较商品价值后作出适当的消费选择。

keypoints.title: 理性消费的判断步骤
keypoints.body: 消费前先区分“需要”和“想要”，再查看预算、比较价格与质量，考虑使用价值和长期影响，最后决定是否购买；购买后记录支出，及时调整消费计划。

exercises.stem: Li has 300 yuan for this month. His textbook, needed next week, costs 180 yuan. His old headphones still work, but he wants a new 260-yuan pair advertised as a limited-time discount. Which plan best shows rational consumption?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Buy the headphones immediately because the advertisement says the discount will end soon.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Buy both items and use borrowed money if the monthly budget is not enough.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Treat the textbook as a need and the headphones as a want; reserve money for the textbook, compare the headphones' price, quality and long-term usefulness, buy them only if affordable, and record the expense.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Choose the most popular headphones and ignore the textbook until there is no money left.

exercises.explanation: C先区分需要和想要，查看预算，再比较价格、质量和长期使用价值，最后根据承受能力决定，并在购买后记录支出，完整体现了理性消费步骤。A受促销影响，B超出承受能力，D忽视实际需要。

keypoints.title: 个人情况与身份的范围
keypoints.body: 个人情况与身份指与“我”有关的基本信息、外貌特征、性格兴趣、家庭和社会角色等内容，常用于介绍自己、认识他人和进行日常交流。

keypoints.title: 身份信息的表达特点
keypoints.body: 个人身份具有独特性，也会随年龄、场合和社会角色变化。表达时应根据交际对象选择合适的信息，做到真实、清楚、得体，并注意保护隐私。

exercises.stem: At the first meeting of an English club, which introduction is the most appropriate?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Hello, I'm Li Hua, a Grade 11 student. I enjoy reading and playing basketball, and I'm happy to join the club.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Hello, my home address is 18 Green Street, and my phone number is 13800000000.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I am the best person here, and nobody can do better than me.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I don't need to tell you anything about myself.

exercises.explanation: A provides basic identity information, interests and current school status in a clear and friendly way suitable for a club meeting. B reveals unnecessary private information, C is boastful and inappropriate, and D does not support normal social communication.

keypoints.title: 生涯规划与愿望的含义
keypoints.body: 生涯规划与计划愿望是根据兴趣、能力和实际条件，对未来学习、职业或生活方向作出设想，并将愿望转化为分阶段、可执行的目标。

keypoints.title: 制定生涯计划的方法
keypoints.body: 先认识自己的兴趣和优势，再明确近期与长远目标；把目标分解为具体任务，安排时间和检验标准，执行中根据新情况及时反思和调整。

exercises.stem: Mia is interested in biology and is good at communicating with people. She hopes to work in public health in the future. Which plan best turns her wish into an executable career plan?

choices.label: A
choices.text: I will work in public health one day. I do not need to decide what to do until I graduate from university.

choices.label: B
choices.text: During the next three months, I will learn about three public-health degree courses, talk to two people in the field, and study biology for two hours each week. At the end of the term, I will review my progress and adjust the plan if necessary.

choices.label: C
choices.text: I will choose the career that my best friend chooses, because we can work together.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I will set a very detailed ten-year plan and follow it exactly, even if my interests or circumstances change.

exercises.explanation: B connects Mia's interests and strengths with a long-term direction, sets specific short-term tasks and a time limit, and includes a review and possible adjustment. A lacks concrete steps, C ignores personal strengths and interests, and D does not allow reflection when circumstances change.

keypoints.title: 学校生活与语言学习的范围
keypoints.body: 学校生活与语言学习指围绕校园日常、课程活动、师生交往、同伴合作和英语学习方法等内容进行理解、表达与交流。

keypoints.title: 校园交流的表达方法
keypoints.body: 先判断交际场景、对象和目的，再选择合适的词语、句式和语气；表达后关注对方反应，必要时补充说明或礼貌确认，以保证信息准确、交流顺畅。

exercises.stem: A student did not hear the teacher's instructions for a group report. Which response is most appropriate?

choices.label: A
choices.text: What? Say it again.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Sorry, I didn't catch the last part. Could you please repeat the deadline? Do you mean we should hand in the report next Friday?

choices.label: C
choices.text: You explained it badly, so I won't do it.

choices.label: D
choices.text: I think everyone knows what to do, so there is no need to ask.

exercises.explanation: B considers the school setting, the teacher as the communication partner, and the purpose of obtaining accurate information. It uses a polite request, explains the difficulty briefly, and confirms the student's understanding. The other responses are impolite, confrontational, or fail to clarify the instructions.

keypoints.title: 关注现实与全球议题
keypoints.body: 以现实社会中受到广泛关注的事件、现象和问题，以及跨国家、跨地区的国际事务和全球议题为内容，学习理解相关信息、观点与影响，形成关注社会、尊重差异和开放沟通的意识。

keypoints.title: 分析与表达的方法
keypoints.body: 接触相关英语材料时，可按“事件或问题—背景—不同观点—影响或对策”梳理信息；表达看法时用事实或材料支持观点，区分事实与意见，并尊重不同立场。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

At an international youth forum, students discussed electronic waste, or e-waste. The problem has grown as people replace phones and computers more often. A report presented at the forum says that 62 million tonnes of e-waste were produced worldwide in 2022, but only 22.3% was formally recycled. Some speakers support right-to-repair rules, arguing that longer-lasting products can reduce waste. Others worry that untrained repairs may create safety risks and say manufacturers need clear standards. The forum finally suggested that governments, companies and consumers share responsibility.

Which response best applies the method of understanding and discussing a global issue?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Right-to-repair rules are the only reasonable policy, and people who disagree do not care about the environment.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The figures prove that every country should immediately adopt exactly the same repair law.

choices.label: C
choices.text: E-waste is a global issue. The figures show its scale, while different views exist about repair safety. Solutions can reduce waste while setting safety standards and considering local conditions.

choices.label: D
choices.text: E-waste is a modern global problem, so individuals cannot do anything about it.

exercises.explanation: C先指出全球性问题，并用材料中的数据说明问题规模；随后区分了支持者和反对者的观点，最后提出兼顾减少废弃物与维修安全的对策，同时考虑不同地区的实际情况。A把意见绝对化，B由数据过度推断，D否定了个人和多方的责任。

keypoints.title: 探究历史社会文化
keypoints.body: 以人类历史发展、社会生活及各民族文化为内容，关注历史事件、社会制度、生活方式、传统习俗、价值观念及其变化，理解社会与文化现象的形成背景。

keypoints.title: 文化现象的多样性
keypoints.body: 历史和社会文化现象具有时代性、地域性与多样性；理解习俗或观念时应结合其历史背景，比较不同文化时既要发现差异，也要看到共同的人类价值。

exercises.stem:
Read the passage and answer the question.

Coming-of-age customs are shaped by history and social life. Japan's Coming-of-Age Day became a national holiday, and local governments hold ceremonies in January; many young adults wear formal clothes. In Mexico and other Latin American communities, some families celebrate a girl's fifteenth birthday with a quinceañera, often combining family, religious and local traditions. Its form differs by region, religion and family. Although the events are not identical, both can recognize growing responsibility and a person's bond with others.

Which conclusion is best supported by the passage?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A custom found in one family can be regarded as a custom shared by everyone in the region.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If two customs are different, they cannot express any common human value.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Cultural practices should be understood through their social and historical backgrounds; their forms may differ while some values overlap.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Because both events mark growing up, they must have the same origin and activities.

exercises.explanation: 文章说明两种成年礼受到不同社会背景影响，形式也因地区、宗教和家庭而变化；但它们都可能表达对成长、责任和群体联系的重视。因此应结合背景理解文化差异，同时看到共同的人类价值。A、B、D都作了绝对化或无依据的推断。

keypoints.title: 节庆的构成与意义
keypoints.body: 以各类节日、纪念日和庆典活动为内容，关注其时间、起源或纪念对象、典型习俗、参与方式及所表达的情感和文化意义。

keypoints.title: 介绍节庆的步骤
keypoints.body: 介绍或比较一个节庆时，可依次说明名称与时间、起源或目的、主要活动、象征意义和个人感受；比较时以具体习俗为依据，不把个别做法当成整个文化的普遍特点。

exercises.stem:
Use the following notes to write an 80–100-word introduction to the Mid-Autumn Festival for an overseas student. Include the festival's name and time, its origin or purpose, major activities, symbolic meaning and your personal feeling. Use expressions such as many families or in some places when a practice is not universal.

Notes:
Name and time: the Mid-Autumn Festival; the fifteenth day of the eighth month in the lunar calendar, usually September or October
Origin or purpose: connected with the harvest and reunion
Activities: family dinner, admiring the full moon, sharing mooncakes; lanterns in some places
Meaning: gratitude, reunion and good wishes
exercises.answer: The Mid-Autumn Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth month in the lunar calendar, usually in September or October. Connected with the harvest, it is also a time for reunion. On that evening, many families have dinner together, admire the full moon and share mooncakes; in some places, people also carry or display lanterns. The round moon and mooncakes symbolize completeness and family unity, while the festival expresses gratitude and good wishes. I enjoy it because it gives my family a chance to slow down and talk.
exercises.explanation: 示例按名称与时间、起源或目的、主要活动、象征意义和个人感受展开，信息顺序清晰，且用many families和in some places避免把个别习俗说成所有人的共同做法。作答内容合理、语言准确且符合字数要求即可。

keypoints.title: 文艺体育的范围
keypoints.body: 以文学作品、视觉与表演艺术以及体育运动为内容，关注作品或项目的形式、主题、表现特点、参与方式及其审美、情感、文化和社会价值。

keypoints.title: 多样形式与共同价值
keypoints.body: 文学、艺术和体育表现形式多样，既能反映个人体验和社会文化，也能传递情感、激发审美与促进交流；评价时应结合具体作品、项目或表现证据。

exercises.stem: At a school arts festival, students present poems about migrant families, display photographs showing changes in their neighborhood, and organize an inclusive relay in which students with different physical abilities cooperate. Which statement best explains why these activities belong to the theme “Literature, Arts and Sports”?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They are mainly ways to win prizes through individual talent.

choices.label: B
choices.text: They use different forms to express experiences and culture, share feelings, and promote communication and inclusion.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Their value depends only on whether the audience understands their technical skills.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Literature, visual art, and sports have no common value because their forms are different.

exercises.explanation: 诗歌、摄影和接力分别属于文学、视觉艺术和体育，形式虽不同，却都表达个人或社会体验，传递情感，并促进交流与包容。因此 B 最能概括它们的共同价值。

keypoints.title: 规则意识与责任担当
keypoints.body: 它体现规则意识、责任意识以及权利义务观。在公共场所应遵守秩序、理性表达；发生冲突时，应通过合法、合理的途径解决。

exercises.stem: During rush hour in a subway station, a passenger cuts into a line and becomes angry when reminded of the rule. What is the most appropriate response for someone who wants to protect public order?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Shout at the passenger and push him out of the line.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Record the conflict and post it online so that strangers can judge it.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Calmly state the rule, keep a safe distance, and ask station staff to handle the problem through proper procedures.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ignore all rules in the station because everyone has the right to do what they want.

exercises.explanation: C 体现了遵守公共规则、理性表达和责任意识；在冲突难以自行解决时，应通过工作人员等合法、合理的途径处理。A 可能激化冲突，B 可能侵犯他人隐私，D 否定了公共秩序。

keypoints.title: 科技影响现代生活
keypoints.body: 科学技术与现代生活，指科学发现和技术应用对人们的学习、工作、交流、出行及生活方式产生的作用和影响。

keypoints.title: 便利与责任并存
keypoints.body: 科技能提高生活效率、拓展生活方式，也可能带来隐私泄露、信息误用等问题。使用科技产品应理性、安全，并关注其社会影响。

exercises.stem: A student uses a free translation app for schoolwork. The app asks for access to the student’s contacts, precise location, microphone, and photo library. Which actions are responsible? Select all that apply.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Read the privacy settings and refuse permissions that are unrelated to translation.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Upload classmates’ private conversations to improve the app without asking for their permission.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Choose a trustworthy version, avoid entering sensitive information, and regularly check its privacy settings.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Share the account password with friends so that they can use the app more conveniently.

exercises.explanation: 科技应用可以提高学习效率，但也可能带来隐私泄露和信息误用风险。A 能减少不必要的数据收集，C 同时考虑了应用可靠性、敏感信息保护和持续管理，体现了理性、安全使用科技的责任。B 和 D 都可能造成隐私或账户安全问题。

keypoints.title: 购物消费服务的含义
keypoints.body: 购物与消费服务，是围绕商品或服务进行需求选择、购买支付、使用咨询、评价反馈及售后处理等活动的生活场景。

keypoints.title: 理性选择并妥善维权
keypoints.body: 购物时先明确需求，再比较价格、质量、功能和售后保障，确认数量与凭证后支付。遇到问题应保留证据，依据约定和规则理性沟通解决。

exercises.stem: Mia bought a pair of headphones online after comparing their price, quality and after-sales service. Two days later, one side stopped working. Which action best follows a rational way to solve the problem?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Throw the headphones away and post an angry message without contacting the seller.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Keep the order record, receipt and photos or videos of the problem, then contact the seller politely according to the return policy.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Buy another pair immediately and ignore the faulty product.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Assume that online shoppers have no rights and take no action.

exercises.explanation: B is the most reasonable choice. When a problem occurs, the consumer should keep relevant evidence such as the order record and receipt, and communicate with the seller calmly according to the agreement and applicable rules. The other actions either give up the opportunity to solve the problem or fail to protect the consumer’s rights.

keypoints.title: 志愿服务的含义
keypoints.body: 社会服务与志愿活动，是个人或组织为帮助他人、服务社区、改善公共环境等，自愿投入时间、知识或劳动的公益活动。

keypoints.title: 自愿公益与合作责任
keypoints.body: 志愿活动具有自愿性和公益性，通常需要服务意识、责任意识与合作精神。参与时应尊重服务对象，遵守活动规则，注意人身安全。

exercises.stem: At a weekend community clean-up, which action best shows the nature and requirements of volunteer service?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Join only because someone promised to pay, and leave as soon as the work becomes difficult.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Choose to help without payment, follow the coordinator’s rules, cooperate with others, respect local residents and use the tools safely.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Take photos of people receiving help without asking for permission.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Ignore the safety instructions so that the work can be finished more quickly.

exercises.explanation: Volunteer service is voluntary and public-minded. A responsible volunteer should serve others, follow rules, cooperate with the team, respect service recipients and protect personal safety. B includes all these qualities, while the other choices show a lack of service, respect or responsibility.

keypoints.title: 旅游与交通的含义
keypoints.body: “旅游与交通”是围绕出行、游览及交通方式展开的主题语境，涉及旅行计划、目的地、路线、交通工具、票务信息、住宿安排和旅途交流等内容。

keypoints.title: 主题内容的主要特点
keypoints.body: 该主题强调在真实出行情境中获取和提供信息，如询问方向、说明行程、比较交通方式、预订服务、遵守交通规则，并关注出行安全与文明礼仪。

exercises.stem: Leo is planning a two-day trip to another city. Which plan best shows effective travel and transportation planning?

choices.label: A
choices.text: He will arrive at the station first and decide where to stay and how to travel after getting there.

choices.label: B
choices.text: He will check train times and fares, book his ticket and hotel, confirm the route, and follow traffic rules during the trip.

choices.label: C
choices.text: He will choose a means of transport only because it looks interesting, without checking the schedule.

choices.label: D
choices.text: He will ask strangers to carry his luggage and cross roads wherever it is convenient.

exercises.explanation: Travel and transportation involve planning the destination, route, transport, tickets and accommodation. They also require attention to safety and civilized behavior. B covers these important aspects, whereas the other choices show poor preparation or unsafe conduct.
